title: Construction Estimating & Lead Generation Virtual Assistant
description:
JBA PROJECTS

POSITION DESCRIPTION

Construction Estimating & Lead Generation Virtual Assistant



Company: JBA Projects Pty Ltd

Location: Remote - Philippines

Employment: Full-time, 40 hours per week

Remuneration: AUD $8-$12 per hour, depending on experience and capability

Reports to: Director, JBA Projects

Career progression: Long-term opportunities for increased responsibility and advancement



ABOUT JBA PROJECTS



JBA Projects is an Australian construction business focused on delivering quality projects, developing strong client relationships and building efficient systems to support long-term growth.



We are seeking a reliable, ambitious and technically capable Virtual Assistant to join our team on a full-time basis.



This is a varied position combining construction measurement, lead generation, marketing, administration and business operations.



We want someone who takes initiative, enjoys solving problems and can help us build more efficient systems.



This is a long-term career opportunity with genuine potential to progress into a broader business operations role.



1. LEAD GENERATION & BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT



Primary responsibility during the initial stages of employment.



Your first major responsibility will be to establish and manage a consistent, scalable lead generation system for JBA Projects.



Key responsibilities include:

- Research builders, developers, contractors and other potential clients.

- Identify business owners, decision-makers and relevant contact details.

- Build and maintain accurate prospect databases.

- Create personalised introductory
s and follow-up sequences.

- Develop and manage outbound
 campaigns.

- Research and implement tools such as Smartlead or similar outreach platforms.

- Use AI to assist with prospect research, personalisation and workflow automation.

- Monitor responses and manage prospect follow-ups.

- Identify qualified opportunities and coordinate appointments.

- Maintain CRM records and track campaign results.

- Protect
 deliverability and follow applicable
 marketing and privacy requirements.

- Document processes and continually improve campaign effectiveness.



Our objective is to establish a system that consistently generates qualified business opportunities, rather than relying indefinitely on manual
 outreach.



Initially, this work will occupy a significant portion of your time.



As the system becomes established and increasingly automated, the manual workload should decrease while lead generation performance is maintained or improved.



This will create opportunities to take on greater responsibility across construction estimating, administration and business operations.



2. CONSTRUCTION ESTIMATING & QUANTITY TAKE-OFFS



Essential technical capability.



You must have demonstrated experience interpreting architectural drawings and completing construction quantity measurements.



A formal quantity surveying qualification is not mandatory. However, practical measurement experience is essential.



Key responsibilities include:

- Read and interpret architectural PDF drawings.

- Understand floor plans, elevations, dimensions and drawing scales.

- Verify drawing scales before taking measurements.

- Accurately measure external building perimeters in linear metres.

- Calculate gross external wall areas in square metres (m²).

- Calculate net external wall areas after specified deductions.

- Identify varying wall heights across different elevations.

- Account for windows, doors and other openings where required.

- Complete quantity take-offs using architectural drawings.

- Prepare accurate measurement spreadsheets and schedules.

- Assist with basic material quantity calculations.

- Identify missing dimensions, discrepancies and drawing inconsistencies.

- Clearly document measurement assumptions and exclusions.

- Assist the Director with basic estimating and quotation preparation.



SPECIFIC TECHNICAL REQUIREMENT



You must be capable of receiving a set of architectural PDF drawings and independently:

1. Identifying and measuring the external building perimeter.

2. Determining relevant external wall heights from plans and elevations.

3. Calculating the total gross external wall area in square metres.

4. Calculating net external wall areas where deductions are specified.

5. Preparing a clear spreadsheet showing measurements, calculations and assumptions.



Experience using Bluebeam Revu, PlanSwift, CostX or similar estimating and PDF measurement software is highly regarded.



Shortlisted applicants will be required to demonstrate their measurement skills through a practical assessment.



3. SOCIAL MEDIA & MARKETING



Assist with maintaining and developing JBA Projects' online presence.



Responsibilities include:

- Prepare and schedule social media posts.

- Write captions for Instagram,
 and 
.

- Create basic graphics and promotional material using Canva.

- Repurpose project photographs, videos and business updates.

- Assist with marketing campaigns and promotional activities.

- Research relevant construction industry content.

- Monitor basic social media enquiries.

- Use AI tools to improve content creation and efficiency.



Advanced graphic design or video editing experience is not essential.



4. XERO & FINANCIAL ADMINISTRATION



Provide basic administrative assistance using Xero accounting software.



Responsibilities may include:

- Prepare draft invoices and quotations for approval.

- Maintain customer and supplier records.

- Organise receipts, invoices and financial documents.

- Assist with accounts receivable administration.

- Prepare payment reminders for outstanding invoices.

- Maintain accurate financial administration records.

- Support the Director and accountant with general tasks.



Previous Xero experience is preferred, although training can be provided.



This is not a qualified accounting position. Financial transactions and approvals remain the responsibility of management.



5. GENERAL ADMINISTRATION & BUSINESS OPERATIONS



Support the Director with a range of administrative and operational activities.



Responsibilities may include:

-
 and inbox management.

- Calendar and appointment coordination.

- Preparing spreadsheets, reports and documents.

- Researching suppliers, subcontractors and business partners.

- Maintaining customer databases and digital records.

- Assisting with customer and supplier correspondence.

- Creating templates, checklists and standard operating procedures.

- Researching and implementing productivity tools.

- Assisting with other reasonable ad hoc tasks as required.



6. SYSTEMS, TECHNOLOGY & AI



We are particularly interested in applicants who enjoy using technology to improve business efficiency.



You will be encouraged to:

- Identify repetitive tasks suitable for automation.

- Research and recommend AI-powered solutions.

- Implement efficient lead generation workflows.

- Improve administrative processes.

- Document repeatable systems and procedures.

- Recommend software that saves time and improves productivity.



Experience with ChatGPT, Smartlead, Make, Zapier or similar platforms is advantageous.



We do not expect expertise in every platform, but you must be comfortable learning new software and applying it to real business problems.



7. ESSENTIAL SKILLS & EXPERIENCE



Applicants must demonstrate:

- Experience interpreting architectural PDF drawings and completing quantity take-offs.

- Ability to measure external building perimeters and calculate external wall areas accurately.

- Experience with lead generation, prospect research or outbound
 campaigns.

- Excellent written and spoken English.

- Strong Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets skills.

- High attention to detail and accurate record-keeping.

- Strong organisational and time management skills.

- Confidence learning and using AI and business software.

- Ability to manage multiple responsibilities independently.

- A reliable internet connection, suitable computer and professional home working environment.

- A proactive, reliable and accountable attitude.



HIGHLY REGARDED

- Experience working with Australian construction businesses.

- Bluebeam, PlanSwift, CostX or similar estimating software experience.

- Smartlead or other automated outreach platform experience.

- CRM management and automation experience.

- Xero accounting software.

- Canva and social media management.

- Experience working directly with a business owner or Director.



8. CAREER PROGRESSION & DEVELOPMENT



This position is intended to evolve as JBA Projects grows.



INITIAL PHASE - ESTABLISHING SYSTEMS

The early focus will include:

- Developing and implementing a lead generation system.

- Building prospect databases and
 campaigns.

- Introducing practical automation and AI tools.

- Completing construction measurement and take-off tasks as required.

- Learning the company's operations and processes.



DEVELOPMENT PHASE - EXPANDING RESPONSIBILITIES

As lead generation processes become increasingly efficient, responsibilities may expand into:

- Greater involvement in construction estimating.

- More financial and operational administration.

- Managing recurring business processes.

- Coordinating customer and supplier communications.

- Developing systems and operational procedures.



LONG-TERM PROGRESSION

Depending on performance, capabilities and company growth, potential progression opportunities include:

- Senior Virtual Assistant

- Construction Estimating & Administration Coordinator

- Business Operations Coordinator

- Executive Assistant to the Director

- Operations or Administration Manager



These are potential pathways rather than guaranteed promotions.



We are seeking someone who wants to grow professionally and become an increasingly valuable member of JBA Projects over the coming years.



9. PERFORMANCE EXPECTATIONS



Performance will be assessed on results, accuracy, reliability and continuous improvement.



Lead generation:

- Quality and accuracy of prospect databases.

- Consistency and effectiveness of outreach campaigns.

- Qualified leads and opportunities generated.

- Effective follow-up and CRM management.

- Improvements in automation and efficiency.



Construction measurement:

- Accuracy of perimeter and wall area calculations.

- Correct interpretation of architectural drawings.

- Timely completion of quantity take-offs.

- Clear documentation of measurements and assumptions.



Business operations:

- Accuracy and quality of administrative work.

- Ability to complete tasks independently.

- Reliability and responsiveness.

- Initiative and problem-solving.

- Contribution to improving company systems.



Specific performance targets will be agreed during onboarding.



10. WORKING ARRANGEMENTS



Employment: Full-time, 40 hours per week

Location: Remote, Philippines

Hourly rate: AUD $8-$12, depending on experience

Working hours: To be agreed, with suitable overlap with Sydney business hours

Duration: Long-term position

Reporting: Directly to the Director



Remuneration and responsibilities may be reviewed as the employee develops and the business grows.



11. IDEAL CANDIDATE



We are looking for someone who:

- Takes initiative rather than waiting for instructions.

- Has genuine construction measurement capability.

- Understands how to research and approach potential customers.

- Enjoys finding better ways to complete tasks.

- Is willing to learn new skills and technology.

- Can balance technical work with administrative responsibilities.

- Communicates clearly and consistently.

- Takes ownership of their work.

- Works independently without constant supervision.

- Wants to develop a long-term career with a growing company.



WHY JOIN JBA PROJECTS?



This is an opportunity to join an ambitious Australian construction business and work directly with its Director.



You will contribute to business growth, develop valuable technical and operational skills, and help build the systems supporting the company's future.



We value reliability, accountability, initiative, accuracy and continuous improvement.



We're not simply hiring someone to complete tasks. We're looking for someone who wants to help build a stronger business and grow with us.



APPLICATION REQUIREMENTS



Applicants should provide:

1. An updated CV outlining relevant experience.

2. A short introduction explaining their experience in construction estimating and lead generation.

3. Details of estimating or architectural measurement software they have used.

4. Examples of previous quantity take-off work, with confidential information removed.

5. Details of relevant experience with
 outreach, AI automation, Xero or other business software.

6. Their expected hourly rate in AUD.

7. Their availability to commence full-time employment.



RECRUITMENT ASSESSMENT



Shortlisted applicants will be asked to complete two practical assessments.



Assessment 1 - Construction Measurement

Using a supplied architectural PDF, calculate the external building perimeter and gross and net external wall areas. Show measurements, calculations and assumptions.



Assessment 2 - Lead Generation

Research five suitable prospective clients, identify relevant decision-makers and prepare a personalised introductory
 with a proposed follow-up approach.



These assessments will help us evaluate practical skills, accuracy, initiative and suitability for the role.



Successful applicants will be invited to interview directly with the Director of JBA Projects.

title: Senior SEO Specialist / SEO Manager
description:
We're hiring someone who knows how to think, not someone who just knows how to follow an SEO checklist.



Marketix Digital is a Sydney-based SEO agency working with B2B, industrial, manufacturing and commercial businesses across Australia.



We're looking for an experienced SEO professional who can independently diagnose problems, identify opportunities, prioritise work and take ownership of client results.



This is not a role for someone who simply follows standard SEO practices, generates recommendations from audit tools or produces lengthy strategy documents without understanding what actually matters.



We care about your judgement, reasoning and ability to execute.



What we're looking for



Someone who can:



Look at a website that isn't ranking and independently determine what's actually holding it back.



Distinguish between genuine SEO problems and issues that tools flag but have little commercial or ranking impact.



Understand search intent, competition, technical SEO, content, internal linking and authority, and how these factors interact.



Prioritise work based on likely impact rather than following a generic 30/60/90-day SEO template.



Understand the commercial value of keywords and focus efforts on generating qualified leads and revenue, not just traffic.



Challenge assumptions, including ours, when the evidence supports a different conclusion.



Execute the work themselves, including technical improvements, content development, on-page optimisation and reporting.



Take full ownership of assigned client accounts without requiring constant direction.



What we don't want



We're not looking for someone who:



Recommends improving page speed on every website without establishing whether speed is actually a meaningful constraint.



Suggests directory submissions, schema markup or more backlinks as default solutions without investigating the existing situation.



Produces AI-generated SEO strategies without critically evaluating the recommendations.



Spreads a few days of work across an entire month to make an activity plan look substantial.



Confuses completing SEO tasks with delivering SEO results.



Needs to be told what to investigate, what to prioritise and what to do next.



Tools like Ahrefs, Semrush, Screaming Frog, Google Search Console and AI are useful. But tools don't replace judgement.



Your responsibilities



You'll be responsible for managing SEO campaigns from diagnosis through to execution.



This includes:



Conducting technical, content and competitor analysis.



Developing commercially focused SEO strategies.



Identifying and resolving ranking and indexing problems.



Conducting keyword research and search intent analysis.



Creating and improving content, landing pages and website architecture.



Implementing on-page and technical SEO improvements.



Analysing rankings, organic traffic, leads and conversions.



Producing meaningful client reports that explain results, challenges and next steps.



Proactively identifying opportunities rather than waiting for instructions.



You'll work directly with the Managing Director, who has over 20 years of SEO experience. You should be comfortable having your recommendations questioned and defending them with evidence.



Experience required



At least 4–5 years of hands-on SEO experience, preferably in an agency environment.



Strong technical SEO and analytical capabilities.



Experience working with WordPress.



Demonstrated ability to independently manage SEO campaigns.



Strong written and spoken English.



Experience with B2B, lead generation or industrial websites is advantageous.



We're more interested in demonstrated capability than job titles or certificates.



How to apply



Please don't send a generic cover letter or a lengthy AI-generated response.



Instead, answer the following question:



A client has been investing in SEO for some time. Their website ranks reasonably well for several keywords, but they're struggling to reach the top positions for their most commercially valuable search terms.



How would you investigate what's preventing further improvement, and how would you d
 what to prioritise?



We're not asking for a checklist of everything you know about SEO.



We want to understand:



How you approach an unfamiliar problem.



What evidence you look for before forming conclusions.



How you distinguish important issues from distractions.



How you d
 which actions deserve priority.



How you determine whether your recommendations are working.



Keep your response concise. Explain your thinking rather than listing tactics.



Applications demonstrating independent reasoning and practical judgement will be prioritised.



About the role



Full-time, long-term position



Remote, Philippines-based



Working with an established Australian SEO agency



Competitive salary based on experience and demonstrated capability



Opportunity to take meaningful ownership of client campaigns



If you're the kind of SEO professional who questions why something isn't working rather than automatically applying another set of best practices, we'd like to hear from you.

title: Virtual Assistant Talent Pool Waves 2, 3 and 4
description:
Video applications only. No CV needed. Medyo mahaba-haba ’to, so brace yourselves. 😄



Hi! We’re opening applications for Waves 2, 3, and 4 of our virtual assistant talent pool at our Florida-based agency. Whether you’ve been a VA for years or you’re just getting curious about VA life, we’d love to meet you and hear what kind of work you enjoy.



We review applications in waves and invite shortlisted applicants to a live screening. From there, we make client introductions when there’s an available assignment that fits your skills, schedule, and preferences.



Two ways to work with us:

- Direct placement. We introduce you to a client and help with the handoff. If you both d
 to move forward, you and the client agree on the work, schedule, and pay before you start. Before we hand you off, the client is your point of contact for day-to-day questions, schedule changes, and payments.  

- Agency-managed. You support a client through our agency. We handle your payments, and you’ll have an account manager for check-ins, coaching, and support. If a client stops responding, treats you poorly, or the assignment feels like a poor fit, you can reach out to us. We’ll help you work through it and support you through the transition if the assignment needs to end.



What to share in your video:

Speak in your own words without reading from a script or notes. Imagine we’re already on a call getting to know each other.  



1. Tell us a little about yourself. What does a typical day look like for you? What kind of work do you enjoy, and what are you looking for right now?



2. Share your availability. Which shift can you comfortably commit to each week, 9 AM–1 PM ET (part-time) or 9 AM–5 PM ET (full-time)? When could you start? If you have commitments during your preferred shift, let us know which days and times. You’re welcome to work with other clients as long as the hours you commit to this assignment are set aside for it. Pick a schedule that leaves you enough time to rest, too.



3. Tell us about your workspace and backup plans. What equipment and internet connection do you use? If your Wi-Fi d
 to take the day off, the power goes out, or your computer stops working mid-shift, what’s your plan? Tell us what backups you already have, how quickly you could get back to work, and how you’d let the client or our team know. If you’re still setting something up, just tell us where you’re at with it.



4. Tell us what kind of work and clients suit you. If you’ve worked as a VA before, share one or two types of clients you feel most confident supporting and up to two types of clients or working arrangements you’d rather pass on next time. You’re welcome to tell us why, and you can keep client names private. Then tell us about one of your longest client engagements, how long you worked with them, and one task you handled yourself. Walk us through it from start to finish. Pick something you know well enough to do on your own, even without AI.



New to VA work? You’re welcome to apply! 

What sparked your interest? Maybe a friend told you about it, you saw it on TV, or you were ready for a change from your usual 9-to-5. Tell us what work you’d like to try and share one task you handled at a previous job, at school, while volunteering, or on a personal project. You can also answer this scenario. A customer asks if their appointment is still on for tomorrow, but you can’t find their name on the calendar. What would you check first, and what would you tell them while you look into it?



5. Tell us which setup you prefer. Direct placement, agency-managed, or open to both? If you’re still figuring it out, that’s okay. Tell us what you’re curious about, and we’ll be happy to talk it through with you.



6. Share your thoughts on brief video check-ins. For agency-managed assignments, your account manager or a team member may occasionally hop on a quick live video call during your shift to confirm you’re personally handling the work and see how things are going. It’s also a chance to ask for help if you’re stuck. How do you feel about that, and what kind of support helps you do your best work?



7. Tell us your expected hourly rate in USD.



8. One last question, just for fun. What’s a plot twist in your life you never saw coming? It can be funny, wild, fun fact.. or as simple as 

“I used to champion in singing contest since grade school hanggang ngayon na may mga apo narin...” 

or "I have Bachelor's degree and all pero pucha, hindi pala sapat, kaylangang humarbat para sa kinabukasan walang katapusan".. 

or "I used to worked sa wet market ng tatay ko... okay naman pero I want to give the best life for them too"

or "I'm a balot vendor, but as you can see, I know I can speak confidently and all and I'm positive I have the chance to work as VA.. sakit na sa lalamunan kaka sigaw ng balot sa gabi mem/serrr" 

... Kahit ano go!  Just share whatever you’re comfortable with.  



Screening and submission:

If you’re shortlisted for either setup, you’ll hear from (Jhon, our VA Scout, or Chi, our agency owner), to schedule a live screening before we introduce you to a client. Please have a valid government-issued ID ready to show privately during the call. Keep your ID out of your application video.



Please apply as an independent freelancer. We accept individual applicants only, and you’ll need to personally handle any work you accept.



Send your video application to:  

 subject: VA Talent Pool Wave 2 3 4| Name | City



If you send a video link, please check that we can open it without requesting access.



Thanks for taking the time to introduce yourself. We’d love to hear from you!



Maraming salamat,

Jhon & Chi B.

title: Social Media Strategist
description:
Trident Digital | Social Media Strategist | Content Strategist

Full-time | Remote Setup/Work from Home

Working Hours: 9AM - 6PM (SGT)

Salary: SGD 1,000/month



About the role

Trident Digital is one of the fastest growing marketing agencies for financial advisors and real estate leaders in Singapore. Our clients are top producers in their industry. They don't hire us to post consistently or chase trends. They hire us to become the most trusted name in their market, so that clients and recruits come to them instead of the other way round.

This role owns that. You'll d
 what each client should be known for, turn that into a content direction, and make sure every video and post that goes out actually builds it. You'll run strategy and insights calls with clients, direct our creative team, and read the numbers to d
 what comes next. If you've ever looked at an advisor's Instagram and thought "I know exactly what's wrong with this," keep reading.



What the setup looks like

You'll work with our operations manager, accounts manager and creative team (videographers, editors and designers), with direct access to the founder. Main platforms are Instagram and
, with TikTok and YouTube as secondary. Market is Singapore. Niches are financial advisory and real estate. Every client's content serves one of two goals: winning clients or recruiting agents. You need to know which one you're writing for, every time.



What you'll do

- Define each client's positioning: what they stand for, who they're for, and why anyone should listen to them over the next advisor

- Build monthly content direction and campaigns that ladder up to the client's sales or recruitment goal

- Run brainstorming and insights calls with clients, pull out the stories and opinions only they have, and turn them into content angles

- Present strategy and content ideas to clients and get alignment without watering the ideas down

- Brief and direct scriptwriters, editors and designers, and review output before it goes out. If it's generic, it doesn't ship

- Review performance monthly, identify what's building authority and what's just filling the feed, and adjust

- Build our playbook as you go, so every winning format and angle compounds across clients



How you'll be measured

- Brand growth for your clients: reach and follower growth within the right audience, not vanity numbers

- Inbound signals: DMs, enquiries, and recruitment interest that clients trace back to content

- Client retention and renewals on the accounts you own

- First-pass approval: how often your direction and ideas land with clients without rounds of rework

- You'll see these numbers every month. Good strategists want to be measured. It's how you prove your thinking works.



You'll do well here if you

- Care about the difference between content that gets views and content that builds trust, and chase the second

- Can walk into a client call, disagree with a top producer respectfully, and back it up with reasoning

- Study why a creator's content works, not just that it works

- Give sharp, specific feedback to creatives instead of "make it pop"

- Take feedback well. Your strategies get challenged and reworked. That's how everyone here improves, including us



This is not for you if you

- Want a job where you clock in, clear tasks and clock out at 6 sharp

- Have freelance clients or side hustles competing for your focus. We're not saying no life outside work. We're saying this has to be your main thing, because split attention shows in the work

- Think strategy means a content calendar full of "tips Tuesday" and trending audio

- Prefer taking client instructions as given rather than pushing for what will actually work

No hard feelings either way. We'd rather both sides know now.



Bonus points

- You've run content strategy for personal brands or service professionals

- Bigger bonus: financial advisors or real estate specifically

- Biggest bonus: you've done it for the Singapore market



What you get

- Real ownership of client accounts. Your strategy d
 what gets made

- Direct access to the founder. You learn how the whole business is built, from authority to inbound

- A team that invests in growth: internal masterminds, sponsored courses, and overseas team trips

- Real room to grow into a senior strategy or account lead role as we scale



How to apply

 
 with the subject line: Your Next Strategist - [Your Full Name]

Your
 should include:

1. Cover letter: years of strategy experience and how you think you can contribute to Trident Digital

2. Updated CV/Resume

3. Expected salary in SGD only

Important Note: Incomplete applications will not be considered.

title: Property Development Assistant | Contractor
description:
Remote | Contract | Sydney business-hours overlap





Take ownership of the detail that keeps property deals moving

We’re looking for a highly organised, numerate and commercially curious contractor who can bring structure, momentum and critical thinking to a busy property pipeline.

Working directly with the Principal, you’ll take ownership of a broad mix of work across property due diligence, feasibility modelling, site research, consultant coordination, deal preparation and day-to-day workflow management.

This won’t suit someone who simply waits for instructions or copies information from one place to another. We’re looking for someone who thinks ahead, asks good questions, reconciles the detail and speaks up when something doesn’t add up.

You’ll have the autonomy to take work from start to finish, with clear access to the Principal when a decision or escalation is needed.



What you’ll take ownership of

• Triage multiple inboxes, identify priorities and maintain visibility of outstanding actions.

• Draft correspondence, coordinate meetings and proactively follow up agents, vendors, lawyers, consultants and partners.

• Review property documents, reconcile leases, income, costs, rates, titles and reports, and prepare clear due diligence findings.

• Build and update feasibility models, documenting assumptions and comparing different scenarios.

• Research planning controls, approval pathways, comparable sales and prospective sites.

• Coordinate consultant briefs and fee proposals, compare scope and pricing, and check invoices against agreed quotes.

• Keep deal information, files and data rooms organised and support the preparation of partner and investor materials.

• Provide concise morning priorities, deal updates and weekly pipeline reporting.

• Document repeatable processes and use AI intelligently to improve summaries, document checks, drafts, trackers and templates.



What we’re looking for

You’ll be someone who can be given an outcome rather than a detailed set of instructions and work out how to get there.



Ideally, you’ll bring:

• Strong numeracy and confidence reconciling documents, schedules, invoices, quotes and financial information.

• Intermediate to advanced Excel or Google Sheets capability, including formulas and financial calculations.

• Clear written English and confidence dealing with external stakeholders over the phone.

• Exceptional attention to detail and an ability to keep multiple workstreams moving.

• A naturally questioning mindset. If something doesn’t make sense, you investigate rather than simply passing it on.

• Confidence using AI tools such as Claude, combined with the judgement to verify outputs carefully.

• The ability to work independently, prioritise competing demands and follow work through to completion.

• Experience within property, finance, accounting, legal support, conveyancing, valuation or project coordination would be advantageous.

Property knowledge can be developed. Strong numeracy, attention to detail, initiative and the willingness to think critically are much harder to teach.



Why this contract is different

This is an opportunity to become a trusted extension of the Principal rather than simply providing administrative support.

As you learn the portfolio and how deals are assessed, the intention is for you to take ownership of more of the recurring work. Automation and AI should progressively remove lower-value repetition, allowing your contribution to move further into feasibility modelling, property research, site analysis and deal preparation.



You’ll have:

• Direct exposure to active property acquisitions and development opportunities.

• Genuine autonomy over your work and how you organise it.

• Direct access to the Principal and the context behind the decisions being made.

• The opportunity to improve systems rather than inherit inefficient processes.

• Scope to introduce practical AI and automation into day-to-day workflows.

• A contract that has room to broaden as trust, capability and knowledge of the portfolio develop.

• The flexibility of remote work with clearly agreed deliverables and working-hour overlap.



What success looks like

Within the first three to six months, you’ll have developed a strong understanding of the portfolio and be independently managing core recurring workflows.

Due diligence and feasibility drafts will be ready for review without repeated prompting, outstanding actions will be actively followed up, and the Principal will have clear visibility across each deal.

Ultimately, success is simple: less time is spent chasing information and managing administration, and more time can be spent making decisions and progressing deals.



Working arrangement

This is a remote contractor opportunity requiring reliable overlap with Sydney business hours so you can communicate directly with Australian agents, consultants and other stakeholders.



The contractor will need to be consistently reachable during agreed core hours, while retaining the independence expected of a contractor in managing their workflow and deliverables.

title: Founder’s Executive and Operations Coordinator
description:
Organizations - Unfeigned International and TrueBridge Brand Collective

Reports to - Founder and CEO

Schedule - Full-time, 40 hours per week, Monday through Friday, following the founder’s Denver work schedule

Compensation - $7–$13 USD per hour based on experience, skills, and assessment results; formal performance and compensation review after 60 days



About the Organizations

Unfeigned International is a youth-development nonprofit ecosystem that connects belonging, creative expression, practical learning, leadership, and meaningful opportunity. Its work includes direct youth programming, the Unfeigned Leadership Institute, Unfeigned Atelier, and Purpose Pathways such as Music and Culinary.

TrueBridge Brand Collective is a premium brand-services company helping corporations, healthcare organizations, educational institutions, government agencies, nonprofits, sports organizations, and professional-services firms strengthen their brands through strategic consultation, executive apparel, curated merchandise, gifting, and memorable brand experiences.

The organizations share a founder and a commitment to purposeful growth, but they maintain separate missions, audiences, finances, clients, records, and operating systems.



Position Summary

We are seeking a proactive, highly organized Founder’s Executive and Operations Coordinator to support the founder and coordinate work across two distinct organizations. This is not a passive task-taking role. The coordinator must turn ideas, commitments, relationships, and opportunities into organized next actions, owners, deadlines, follow-up, and concise updates—without exceeding delegated authority.

The role combines executive assistance, project coordination, CRM management, relationship follow-up, marketing coordination, nonprofit administration, and commercial client-service support. The right candidate communicates professionally, anticipates needs, protects confidential information, and keeps both organizations moving while preserving clear operational boundaries between them.



Core Responsibilities

• Manage the founder’s calendar, inbox workflow, meetings, priorities, reminders, and follow-up.

• Prepare meeting agendas, briefing notes, action lists, and decision-ready updates.

• Convert verbal discussions and new ideas into organized tasks with owners, deadlines, priorities, and approval points.

• Maintain separate systems, files, contacts, pipelines, expenses, credentials, and reporting for both organizations.

• Track deadlines, commitments, proposals, partnerships, events, client projects, and outstanding decisions.

• Coordinate routine communication with clients, donors, funders, partners, vendors, prospects, and approved program contacts.

• Research qualified opportunities and prepare organized findings and recommended next steps.

• Coordinate approved content, newsletters, case studies, presentations, and outreach.

• Maintain standard operating procedures, reusable templates, and accurate project records.

• Organize Google Drive folders, files, permissions, naming conventions, and archives for both organizations.

• Produce a concise weekly founder briefing and maintain a decision log.

• Track work time and assigned expenses separately for each organization.

• Protect confidential client, donor, employee, youth, family, vendor, and organizational information.



Unfeigned International Coordination

• Maintain donor, sponsor, grant, program, community-partner, and stewardship records and follow-up.

• Maintain grant and reporting calendars and track required supporting documents.

• Coordinate partnership meetings, proposal assembly, approved outreach, and donor or sponsor follow-up.

• Support youth-program and community-event schedules, logistics, materials, communications, permissions, and records.

• Coordinate program, donor, community, and fundraising content only through approved channels.

• Use heightened care with youth and family information and immediately escalate safety, conduct, privacy, or boundary concerns.

Important: Grant writing and fundraising strategy are not assumed to be core duties, although relevant experience is helpful.



Grant Writer Coordination

• Maintain the grant calendar and track drafts, required documents, approvals, submissions, awards, and reporting deadlines.

• Collect and organize approved program, budget, organizational, and supporting information for the grant writer.

• Coordinate questions, meetings, document requests, and follow-up among the founder, grant writer, and relevant team members.

• Store final submissions and funder correspondence in the correct Unfeigned records.

• Do not change outcomes, financial figures, grant strategy, or funder commitments without authorization.



TrueBridge Brand Collective Coordination

• Maintain prospect, consultation, proposal, client, vendor, procurement, production, delivery, and follow-up pipelines.

• Coordinate discovery calls, consultation questionnaires, proposals, client approvals, artwork and asset collection, and project updates.

• Track vendor quotes, product information, production milestones, quality checkpoints, delivery schedules, and invoice status.

• Keep each project visible from prospect and consultation through proposal, approval, production, delivery, and client follow-up.

• Support approved client outreach, newsletters, case studies, social content, and portfolio documentation.

• Flag delays, missing approvals, budget concerns, or quality risks before they become emergencies.



Operational Boundaries

The coordinator must understand the difference between coordination authority and decision authority. Information or resources belonging to one organization may not be used for the other without authorization.



May Handle Within Approved Procedures

• Routine scheduling and confirmations

• CRM updates, task tracking, and status requests

• Authorized follow-up and approved communications

• Document organization and routine project or vendor coordination



Must Prepare for Founder Approval

• Proposals, new public messaging, and significant partnership communications

• Sensitive client, donor, family, or stakeholder messages

• Pricing exceptions, scope changes, budget commitments, or cross-organization activity



Reserved for the Founder or Authorized Decision Maker

• Contracts, legal decisions, financial transfers, signatures, and expenditure approvals

• Fundraising representations, personnel decisions, and material commercial terms

• Sensitive youth or family i
 and strategic decisions



Required Qualifications

• At least three years of experience in executive assistance, operations, project coordination, client service, nonprofit administration, marketing coordination, or a related field.

• Excellent written and spoken English with professional business communication skills.

• Demonstrated ability to manage competing priorities, deadlines, and stakeholders with limited supervision.

• Experience using calendars, cloud storage, spreadsheets, presentation tools, and project-management platforms.

• Advanced Google Drive proficiency, including folder architecture, search, sharing permissions, naming and version control, deduplication, and separated organizational access.

• Experience maintaining a CRM or another structured relationship and follow-up system.

• Strong judgment, discretion, accuracy, initiative, and follow-through.

• Ability to prepare concise summaries and recommended next steps rather than forwarding unorganized information.

• Reliable internet connection, professional remote-work environment, and dependable availability during agreed working hours.

• Ability to maintain strict confidentiality and operational separation between two organizations.



Preferred Experience

• Supporting a founder, executive, or multiple related organizations

• Nonprofit partnerships, donor stewardship, sponsorships, grants, or community programs

• Corporate client service, branded merchandise, procurement, events, or vendor management

• Canva,
 marketing, CRM, project-management, and basic workflow automation tools

• Creating standard operating procedures, templates, dashboards, or weekly reports



Technology Expectations

Google Drive and Google Workspace proficiency is required. The coordinator must be able to build intuitive folder structures, find and archive files, manage links and permissions, control naming and versions, and keep Unfeigned and TrueBridge content properly separated. Candidates should also be comfortable with CRM and project-management systems, spreadsheets, presentation tools, Canva,
 marketing, Zoom or Teams, password management, and basic automation.



Accountant Coordination

• Organize invoices, receipts, reimbursements, payment-status information, and supporting records for the accountant.

• Maintain strict separation between Unfeigned and TrueBridge financial documents and expenses.

• Track missing records and coordinate routine questions, deadlines, and document requests between the founder and accountant.

• Prepare organized monthly information for professional review without changing accounting records independently.

• Do not approve expenses, transfer funds, sign checks or contracts, or make accounting, tax, payroll, or worker-classification decisions.



Success Measures and 60 Day Review

The selected candidate will receive a formal performance and compensation review after 60 days. The review does not guarantee an increase; it evaluates demonstrated performance, reliability, role ownership, communication, and the scope of responsibilities successfully assumed.

• Weekly founder briefings are accurate, concise, and consistently delivered.

• Key donor, partner, prospect, client, grant, event, and production pipelines are current.

• Active relationships and projects have documented owners, deadlines, statuses, and next actions.

• Routine follow-up no longer depends on the founder remembering or chasing it.

• Risks, delays, and missing decisions are identified early.

• Records, time, expenses, credentials, and relationship data remain properly separated.

• Communication is professional, timely, and appropriate to each organization.



Remote Work Requirements

• This is a remote position intended for a professional based in the Philippines.

• The standard schedule is 40 hours per week, Monday through Friday, following the founder’s Denver, Colorado work schedule.

• The role requires at least six hours of live overlap with the founder’s Mountain Time business day. The remaining two hours may be completed on an agreed flexible schedule.

• A typical full-overlap schedule is approximately 10:00 p.m.–6:00 a.m. Philippine Time while Denver observes Mountain Daylight Time and 11:00 p.m.–7:00 a.m. Philippine Time while Denver observes Mountain Standard Time.

• Because Denver observes daylight saving time and the Philippines does not, the schedule will shift by one hour seasonally. The agreed schedule must be followed consistently.

• The candidate must maintain reliable internet, a working computer, and a private environment suitable for confidential calls and records.

• Occasional schedule adjustments may be requested for important meetings, events, or deadlines with reasonable notice.



Compensation

The hourly range is $7–$13 USD, depending on relevant experience, communication ability, demonstrated judgment, technical proficiency, and assessment results. A formal performance and compensation review will take place after 60 days.



How to Apply

Submit one application containing all of the items below. Applications that do not follow the instructions or answer every question may not be considered.

• Résumé

• A short letter explaining why this specific role fits your experience

title: Executive Operations Partner

Job Overview



We are looking for an experienced Solar Engineer and Technician to support our residential and commercial solar projects from initial customer approval all the way through Permission to Operate (PTO). You will play a critical role in ensuring projects move smoothly through site assessment, system design, permitting, interconnection, and post-installation closeout.

If you have hands-on experience in the solar industry and know how to take a project across the finish line without bottlenecks, we want to hear from you.

Qualifications

 * Proven experience working on both residential and commercial solar PV installations (battery storage/ESS experience is a strong plus).

 * Proficiency in solar design and CAD software (e.g., AutoCAD, Aurora Solar, HelioScope, Scanifly).

 * Solid understanding of electrical load calculations, NEC codes, and utility interconnection requirements (US market experience preferred).

 * Strong written and spoken English communication skills for coordinating with engineers, utilities, and internal teams.

 * Reliable high-speed internet and a dedicated workspace.

How to Apply

To be considered for this role, please submit the following in your application:

In the video, introduce yourself and walk us through your hands-on experience taking solar projects from customer approval to PTO, including the software and equipment you have worked with.

title: Multifamily Underwriting & Financial Modeling Tutor
description:
I'm a commercial real estate professional specializing in multifamily investment sales. I'm seeking a part-time private tutor to teach me multifamily underwriting and financial modeling the way it's taught in a university-level real estate development program — structured, rigorous, and built around a proper textbook curriculum.



This is a teaching engagement, not a one-off training session. I want someone who can guide me from fundamentals through a complete, self-built multifamily underwriting and waterfall model, with assessments along the way to prove I've actually learned the material.



At a glance:

• Role: Private tutor / instructor 

• Schedule: Twice per week (two 60–90 minute remote sessions)

• Format: Fully remote via Zoom/Teams with screen sharing and Excel work-alongs

• Rate: $9/hour USD (paid via Wise)

• Start date: Immediate, upon successful interview



What You'll Be Teaching:

A structured curriculum of your own proposal, modeled on a university real estate development / real estate finance program, working out of a recognized textbook (e.g., Peter Linneman's Real Estate Finance and Investments or comparable). You will propose the syllabus and textbook in your application.



Core topic areas:

1. Foundations — time value of money, NPV/IRR/MIRR, cap rates, NOI, basis points, leverage concepts

2. Multifamily underwriting — rent rolls, market rents, vacancy and loss to lease, operating expenses and expense ratios, capital expenditures, debt terms (amortization, DSCR, loan sizing), investor pro forma conventions

3. Financial modeling in Excel — building a complete multifamily acquisition model from scratch, with sensitivity tables, scenario analysis, and clean formatting standards

4. Waterfalls and syndication math — preferred returns, return of capital, catch-up tranches, promote/carried interest, IRR-hurdle-based distribution waterfalls for LP/GP structures

5. Development topics — land/entitlement basics, ground-up feasibility analysis, construction budgeting and draws, permanent loan takeout, developer profit and developer waterfalls



Curriculum Structure Requirements:

• University-style curriculum: You will map out a semester-style syllabus with weekly topics tied to assigned textbook readings before we begin.

• Work out of a textbook: Each session should build on assigned reading and problem sets.

• Quizzes: Short quizzes at regular mile markers (roughly every 3–4 weeks) covering prior material.

• Tests/exams: Longer assessments at major milestones (mid-program and capstone), including a hands-on modeling exam where I build or repair a model under time constraint.

• Capstone project: A complete multifamily acquisition model built by me from scratch, including an equity waterfall tab, reviewed and graded by you.



Qualifications:

• Hands-on experience underwriting or acquiring multifamily assets (e.g., work at an acquisitions shop, appraisal firm, brokerage, developer, or lending institution)

• Advanced, demonstrable Excel modeling skills (clean formula design, scenario toggles, waterfall logic — no copy-paste templates)

• Practical familiarity with distribution waterfall math and GP/LP structures

• Prior tutoring, teaching, or training experience required

• Reliable high-speed internet, quiet workspace, and dual-screen setup for screen-share lessons

• Ability to commit to a fixed twice-weekly schedule for at least 3–6 months



Nice to Have:

• Familiarity with US markets and conventions (Argus, CoStar, or similar exposure is a plus but not required — this course is Excel-native)

• Experience building development / construction-draw models

• Textbook-honed problem-solving: you should be comfortable assigning and grading exercises from a real estate finance text



To Apply:

Please send

1. A resume

2. A brief summary of your multifamily underwriting/modeling experience (deals, roles, tools)

3. A proposed curriculum outline: the textbook you'd use, a week-by-week topic list

4. A sample of your modeling work (screenshots welcome; formulas visible)

5. Your availability (EST) and confirmation you can commit to two sessions per week

title: Carrier Onboarding Representative
description:
GH Logistics is a growing freight brokerage and asset-based logistics company specializing in dry van and reefer freight. Our strength comes from reliable carrier partnerships, disciplined execution, clean communication, and scalable capacity across the U.S. As our network continues to expand, we are looking for a Carrier Onboarding Representative to help identify, verify, onboard, and develop relationships with reliable trucking carriers across our priority markets.



This role is not just about adding carriers to our network. It is about building a dependable carrier base, maintaining strong relationships, and ensuring our operations teams have access to qualified carriers when capacity is needed.



Role Overview

You are responsible for sourcing, vetting, onboarding, and maintaining relationships with qualified carriers while supporting the growth and reliability of GH Logistics' carrier network. You will work directly with U.S.-based trucking companies to identify carriers operating in our priority markets, verify their qualifications, complete onboarding requirements, and maintain accurate carrier records.



This is a high volume and phone-based role that requires persistence, organization, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced freight environment. This role does not involve booking loads or negotiating freight rates. Your primary responsibility is to ensure qualified, verified carriers are properly onboarded, documented, and connected with the appropriate internal teams. This role is strictly for fluent English speakers, as the position requires constant communication with U.S.-based carriers and internal team members throughout the shift.



What You'll Be Doing



Carrier Sourcing and Network Development

• Make at least 30 outbound calls daily to identify and connect with potential carriers.

• Handle approximately 20 inbound calls daily related to carrier inquiries, onboarding, and follow-ups.

• Identify reliable carriers actively operating in GH Logistics' priority markets.

• Build professional relationships with carrier owners, dispatchers, and fleet representatives.

• Introduce GH Logistics and explain our carrier onboarding process, freight network, and communication expectations.

• Identify carrier operating areas, preferred lanes, equipment types, and availability.

• Follow up with existing carriers to maintain engagement and updated information.

• Focus on developing long-term carrier relationships rather than simply increasing onboarding numbers.



Carrier Verification and Fraud Prevention

• Verify carriers using approved tools

• Review carrier operating authority, insurance coverage, safety records, and compliance information.

• Check the company's Do Not Use (DNU) list before proceeding with onboarding.

• Identify potential red flags involving fraud, double brokering, or suspicious carrier information.

• Ensure all verification requirements are completed before onboarding a carrier.

• Escalate questionable carriers or compliance concerns to management.

• Follow company-approved verification procedures without skipping required steps.



Carrier Onboarding and Documentation

• Successfully onboard at least 3 qualified carriers daily.

• Complete all required carrier onboarding documentation accurately and efficiently.

• Ensure carrier information and compliance records are complete and up to date.

• Create at least 1 group chat daily with a newly onboarded carrier to establish direct communication.

• Immediately post every newly onboarded carrier in the designated channel.

• Ensure every onboarded carrier is properly recorded and accessible to the appropriate internal teams.

• Coordinate with internal teams to ensure newly onboarded carriers are ready for potential freight opportunities.



Carrier Relationship Management and Tracking

• Update and maintain spreadsheet daily.

• Track carrier onboarding activity, call volume, follow-ups, and carrier information.

• Maintain accurate carrier contact information, operating preferences, and relevant details.

• Monitor existing carrier records and update information as needed.

• Ensure all onboarded carriers are properly documented and included in the appropriate tracking systems.

• Maintain organized daily activity logs and communication records.

• Coordinate with internal teams to address carrier-related inquiries or concerns.



Directory and Communication Management

• Maintain the GH Logistics carrier directory and designated group chats.

• Add new contacts and remove outdated or inactive members as needed.

• Ensure appropriate team members are included in required communication groups.

• Maintain accurate group membership and required administrative access.

• Escalate missing information, access restrictions, or communication issues to management.

• Keep carrier communication organized, professional, and accessible to internal teams.



What Success Looks Like

• Consistently completes 30 outbound calls daily.

• Handles approximately 20 inbound calls daily.

• Successfully onboards at least 3 qualified carriers daily.

• Creates at least 1 group chat daily with a newly onboarded carrier.

• Every onboarded carrier is properly verified through approved tools.

• No carriers on the DNU list are onboarded.

• All newly onboarded carriers are immediately posted in the communication channel.

• Carrier records, tracking spreadsheets, and directories remain accurate and updated.

• Builds and maintains reliable carrier relationships that support long-term network growth.

• Consistently meets daily activity and onboarding targets without sacrificing quality.

• Demonstrates urgency, accountability, and strong communication in a fast-paced freight environment.



Who We're Looking For

• Experience in Carrier Onboarding, Carrier Sales, Freight Brokerage, Dispatch, or U.S. Trucking Operations is preferred.

• Fluent English communication skills, both verbal and written.

• Comfortable making high volume outbound calls and handling inbound carrier inquiries.

• Familiarity with U.S. carrier verification, insurance, operating authority, and safety compliance.

• Experience with logistiics platforms is a strong advantage.

• Highly organized, tech-savvy, and comfortable managing multiple spreadsheets and communication channels.

• Strong attention to detail when reviewing carrier documentation and maintaining records.

• Proactive, persistent, and confident when communicating with trucking companies.

• Capable of building professional relationships and maintaining consistent carrier follow-ups.

• Thrives in a fast-paced, high-urgency freight environment.

• Performance-driven, KPI-oriented, and comfortable working with measurable daily targets.

• Follows instructions consistently and executes tasks with precision.

• Able to work independently while coordinating effectively with internal teams.

• Team-oriented, coachable, and open to feedback without ego.



Schedule and Work Setup

• Work Arrangement: Full-Time Remote | Direct Engagement with a US Company

• Available shift: Monday -  Friday 7 AM - 5 PM Central Time

• Active, attentive, and proactive Zoom participation with camera on is required throughout scheduled shifts.

• Time tracking software is used for accountability and performance monitoring.

• Reliable internet connection, backup internet and power supply, and a suitable remote workspace are required.



What You'll Get

• Long-Term Opportunity: An ongoing leadership role within a growing US logistics company.

• Monthly Stipend: $75 monthly insurance stipend, with eligibility beginning after 30 days of engagement.

• Regular Payment Schedule: Payments processed twice monthly according to established payroll schedules.

• Direct US Operations Exposure: Work closely with US-based logistics teams and operational leadership.

• Meaningful Operational Impact: Help build a reliable carrier network, prevent freight fraud through proper verification, and strengthen GH Logistics' capacity to support consistent freight coverage.

• Structured Workflows: Established carrier onboarding procedures, clear daily KPIs, organized tracking systems, and opportunities to improve carrier relationships and network efficiency.



If you're someone who enjoys connecting with people, thrives in a high-volume calling environment, and takes pride in building reliable business relationships, we'd love to hear from you.



Apply Here: 



Note: After submission, our team will review your information and contact you if you meet the qualifications for the role. Candidates with direct experience in U.S. freight brokerage, carrier onboarding, or trucking operations will be prioritized.

title: Trailer Management Admin
description:
GH Logistics (AJG Transport) is a high performance freight brokerage and asset based logistics company specializing in dry van and refrigerated freight. We move quickly, but we move with structure. Our operation is built on real-time visibility, disciplined execution, and clear communication. We take pride in keeping freight organized, assets accounted for, and operations running cleanly from pickup to delivery.



If you’re someone who enjoys structured execution, asset visibility, and maintaining operational accuracy behind the scenes, you’ll feel right at home here.



Role Overview

You support the Trailer Manager in overseeing a fleet of 1000+ trailers across multiple carriers and terminals. You play a critical role in ensuring every trailer is accounted for, properly assigned, compliant, and operational. This is not a passive data-entry role. You’re the person who keeps the fleet picture accurate, coordinates trailer repair concerns, and flags problems before they cost us time and money.



You should be familiar with common trailer repair and maintenance issues and understand how to coordinate practical solutions with drivers, terminals, vendors, and maintenance teams. If you thrive on structure, take pride in clean records, and don’t let things slip through the cracks, this role was built for you.



What You’ll Be Doing

• Monitor, update, and reconcile trailer locations across the network on a daily basis

• Coordinate with route supervisors, internal team, dispatchers, carriers, drivers, and terminals to ensure accurate trailer assignments and timely movement

• Track trailer availability, maintenance schedules, and repair status

• Identify trailer issues, assess their operational impact, and coordinate the appropriate repair solution

• Maintain accurate and up-to-date trailer documentation (registrations, inspections, tags, insurance)

• Support reporting on trailer utilization, downtime, and compliance

• Identify discrepancies, missing updates, or unreported trailer statuses and escalate promptly

• Assist in improving internal trailer tracking systems for better visibility and accuracy

• Execute processes consistently with strong attention to detail

• Collaborate cross-functionally with dispatch, compliance, and maintenance teams



What Success Looks Like

• Trailer locations and statuses are consistently accurate and fully reconciled

• Assignments, availability, and movements are properly documented and updated in real time

• Maintenance, repair, and compliance records are complete and up to date

• Trailer defects and repair needs are identified early, properly communicated, and resolved efficiently

• Discrepancies are identified early and resolved before impacting operations

• Reporting on utilization and downtime is clean, accurate, and actionable

• Communication across departments is clear, timely, and structured



Who We’re Looking For

• Experience in fleet management, trailer maintenance coordination, logistics coordination, truck or trailer repairs, dispatch, or similar live operational roles (not general admin work)

• Familiarity with common dry van and refrigerated trailer repairs, defects, and maintenance concerns

• Ability to understand trailer repair issues, determine the appropriate next steps, and coordinate solutions

• Knowledge of common trailer components and issues, such as tires, brakes, lights, doors, landing gear, air lines, electrical systems, refrigeration units, and structural damage, is strongly preferred

• Strong attention to detail with high accuracy in tracking and record-keeping

• Organized and capable of managing multiple data points across systems and teams

• Clear and professional communication skills across departments

• Familiarity with platforms such as Samsara, LoadStop, or similar tracking systems is a plus

• Proactive mindset, able to identify and address issues before they escalate

• Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills in a fast-paced environment

• Minimum 45 WPM typing speed

• Proficient in Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, and Logistics tools

• Reliable internet connection and fully equipped remote work setup

• Team oriented, coachable, and aligned with structured processes



Schedule & Work Setup

• Full time permanent remote role

• Direct Hire to a US Company (not agency or BPO)

• Current needed shifts: Thursday - Monday 8 PM - 6 AM CST | Tuesday - Saturday 8 PM - 6 AM CST

• Reliable home office setup and back up internet and power stations

• Zoom presence required (camera on throughout shift)

• Hubstaff time tracking during shifts.



What You'll Get

• Independent Contractor Setup

• $75 monthly insurance stipend (eligibility begins 30 days after hire)

• Paid biweekly. No delayed payments and no excuses.

• Stable & long-term position. This is not project-based nor seasonal. We're building a team and we need people who want to build with us.

• Direct access to US executive leadership. You're not buried in a call center reporting to a middle manager. You work directly with our operations team.

• Real operations work.



Who Thrives Here

• People who've worked in a US freight brokerage or 3PL and want something more stable

• Former fleet coordinators, logistics admins, or dispatch support staff who are tired of BPO environments

• Fleet admins who take ownership. You don't clock in and zone out. You manage trailers like they are your business.

• People who can recognize trailer issues, coordinate repairs, follow up consistently, and ensure equipment returns to service as quickly as possible

• People who want to grow into leadership but need the right company to do it in.



Who This Isn't For

• General VAs looking for easy remote work. This is real logistics and not admin tasks.

• People who need constant supervision or step by step instructions for every task

• Anyone who can't commit to US shift hours consistently

• Candidates without actual freight/logistics experience. We don't have time to teach the basics.

• Candidates who are unfamiliar with trailer maintenance concerns or are uncomfortable coordinating repairs and operational solutions



This role is built for someone who takes pride in maintaining control over moving assets, ensuring trailers are accounted for, properly assigned, properly repaired, and always operational. If you value structure, accuracy, problem-solving, and keeping operations running clean behind the scenes, you’ll thrive in this role.

title: Experienced Outbound Sales Closer / Appointment Setter (3+ Years Exp)
description:
About us

Bee Man Dan LLC is a Houston, Texas bee removal and hive relocation company. We find hives with thermal imaging, have served Houston families since 2015, and are 5-star Google-rated. Our operations team works remotely from the Philippines.



What you will do

You are our closer. Your job is to turn warm leads into booked jobs and sales.



- Close hive removal customers: call back hive removal quote requests and warm leads, confirm the address and ZIP code, explain the value of safe, professional removal and relocation, handle price objections, and book the job using our script and talking points.

- Buzz for Gold: call people who signed up for our collectible silver coin promotion and have not purchased yet. Answer questions clearly and honestly, and guide them to complete the purchase. No false claims and no promises about results. (about 2 to 3 hours a day)

- Research referral partners (pest control companies, property managers, real estate agents, roofers) and record them in a tracker. B2B calling starts in spring.

- Log every call and outcome in our call tracker and ClickUp, and hand off bookings to the right teammate.

- Build fresh leads through circle prospecting when call volume is low.



Incentives (on top of base pay)



- You earn a per-coin incentive for every Buzz for Gold coin you close, and the rate goes up as volume goes up.

- You earn a per-booking incentive for every hive removal you book that is completed.

- Retention bonuses at 30 and 60 days.

- Incentives are paid at your biweekly payday, and the full structure is shared with the selected candidate at hiring.

- Because you are calling warm leads, strong callers can earn well above the base rate. Results depend on lead volume and your calls, and we do not guarantee earnings.



What we are looking for

This is NOT an entry-level role. We need a proven outbound closer who can show results. Please apply only if you meet the requirements below.



Required:



- At least 3 years of OUTBOUND phone sales experience (cold calling, lead follow-up, or appointment setting). 

- A track record of closing sales and booking appointments in real estate cold calling (expired, FSBO, absentee owners), B2B appointment setting, pest control, or home services.

- You can tell us your numbers: calls per day, appointments booked or sales closed per week or month, and one result you are proud of.

- Comfortable handling objections and asking for the sale or the appointment without pressure tactics.

- Clear, natural spoken English with US callers.

- Honest, coachable, and able to follow a script.

- Quiet workspace, headset, stable internet, and a backup connection or power.



Applications that do not state years of outbound experience and the industry will not be reviewed.



Nice to have (we will train you):



- US pest control, home services, or lead callback experience

- Comfortable researching online and keeping a clean Google Sheet



Schedule

Monday to Friday, 3 to 5 hours a day during Central Time (Houston) daytime hours, which is evening or overnight in the Philippines. Exact shift hours are confirmed at hiring and kept consistent.



Terms

1. Independent contractor, paid biweekly via Wise or direct to bank. 

2. Check-in at the end of week 1; decision at the end of the week.

3. Strong performers can move to more hours.



How to apply



1. Start your message with the word BEE.

2. Attach your resume.

3. Send a 2 to 3 minute VIDEO (strongly preferred). Use a Loom, Google Drive or unlisted YouTube link and make sure we can open it. Audio-only is accepted, but video applications are reviewed first. Show your face, sit in a quiet room, and use your headset. Say your name and the word BEE, then answer:

a) Tell us about your calling experience: the industry, how many years, calls per day, your close or booking rate, and one result you are proud of.

b) A homeowner says "That's too expensive" or "I'll think about it" after hearing the price. What do you say next, honestly and without pressure?

c) You are calling someone who signed up for our silver coin promotion but has not bought yet. Give us your opening 20 seconds.

d) Write your available hours in Central Time and your earliest start date.

title: INSURANCE PAYMENT POSTING & RECONCILIATION ASSISTANT

 with ALL of the following:

title: E-commerce Inventory & Listings Specialist (Amazon, Shopify)
description:
E-commerce Inventory & Listings Specialist (Amazon, Shopify)

Full-time, remote. Monday to Friday, 8:00am to 5:00pm US Central (10:00pm to 7:00am Manila time from November to March; 9:00pm to 6:00am from March to November). Reports to Michelle, Operations.



IF YOU'VE EVER CAUGHT A BAD FLAT FILE BEFORE IT WENT LIVE, READ ON

The inventory file says one number, the warehouse says another, and the upload is due in the morning. Most people upload and hope. We're looking for the person who stops, traces the gap to its source, and fixes it first.



ABOUT LUX & NYX

Lux & Nyx designs architectural handbags for professional women who refuse to choose between style and function. Featured in Forbes, Refinery29, NPR, and Marie Claire. We sell across Shopify DTC, Amazon, Nordstrom, and Macy's, and through a corporate gifting channel. Remote-first team led by founder Lisa Hu.



THE ROLE

You'll own the accuracy of everything we put on a marketplace and every number we report on: available-to-sell and inventory files, listings on Amazon, Shopify and our retail partners, our daily sales and ads reports, and the orders, returns and customer messages that follow. You'll be our warehouse's main contact, and you'll work closely with Michelle, who leads operations.



WHAT YOU'LL OWN

• Inventory and available-to-sell files: keep one master product sheet as the source, reconcile inventory and ATS files for SKU, UPC and quantity before every upload, and check them live after. That includes Amazon, Shopify, our retail portals, and our ESP and SAGE corporate gifting catalogs.

• Listings: launches, price updates, retired SKUs, flat files and approved promotions, plus a weekly check for suppressed or rejected listings.

• Reporting: prepare our daily sales report and marketing ads reports, check every number against its source, and flag what doesn't add up.

• Orders, returns and the warehouse: keep orders moving, check the returns, files and invoices our warehouse sends, and follow up with vendors until every issue is closed.

• Customer care and reviews: answer customers within one business day, warmly and in our brand voice, including refunds, returns and warranty claims.

• Production support: prepare purchase orders, packing lists and shipping documents from approved inputs for our weekly production meeting.

• Tickets and SOPs: follow every Seller Support and portal ticket until it's fixed, and write down every step you own.



Not part of this role: pricing, budget and other financial decisions, paid ads management, forecasting, corporate gifting quotes and orders (another teammate owns those), running the warehouse floor, product design, and accounting.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

• You stop rather than upload. If a count, price or SKU doesn't match its source, nothing goes live until it does. That's the number one thing.

• Hands-on listing work for a brand or seller: Amazon flat files, Seller Central, retailer portals or Shopify product setup, including fixing rejected or suppressed listings.

• 2+ years reconciling inventory, orders, invoices or e-commerce reports for someone else to act on.

• Strong spreadsheet skills: formulas, lookups and reconciliations.

• Comfortable with totals, per-unit costs and variances, and you can show where every figure came from.

• Customer care for an online brand, written warmly and clearly.

• You work it out yourself. AI can help you draft or double-check, but the thinking and the judgment are yours.

• Clear, polished written English, and steady follow-through without anyone having to chase you.

• Here for the long haul: you want to own this work and get great at it.



A strong plus: Mirakl, ShipStation, ESP or SAGE catalogs, EDI, packing lists and carton planning, or working day to day with a 3PL.



You don't need every box ticked. If you catch the mistake before it goes live and you can show where every number came from, we want to hear from you.



WHAT GREAT LOOKS LIKE

• Every upload matches the master sheet, and nothing goes live with an open question.

• Every report goes out on time and matches its source.

• Customers hear back within one business day.

• Every open ticket and vendor issue has a next step.



PAY AND BENEFITS

US$600 to $1,300 a month depending on experience, plus a performance bonus. Paid PTO. Health stipend. Weekly 1:1 with Michelle, async-first on Slack.



HOW TO APPLY

Apply right here on OnlineJobs.ph. Your application must do three things:



1. Start with the word TRACE.

2. Answer this in your own words: It's Monday, December 21. Tomorrow at 10:00am US Central you upload the Amazon available-to-sell file. Last Friday's inventory file shows 448 units of the Belt Bag in Black. On Saturday, 30 units shipped on a corporate order. Today's warehouse count shows 412 units. 12 customer returns arrived Friday and haven't been inspected yet. The warehouse is closed Thursday and Friday for Christmas. What number would you upload, what do you check before you do, who do you tell, and by when?

3. Include your resume, or a Google Drive link to it that opens.



Applications missing any of the three won't be reviewed. Those three steps are deliberate: they show us, before we ever meet, whether you read carefully and own the details.



NEXT STEPS

If you're shortlisted: a short form and a recorded video intro, then a paid skills test, then a call with our founder where you'll walk us through some of your answers. Then an offer.
