title: Promo Account & Order Coordinator
description:
Promo Account & Order Coordinator

Full-time, remote. Monday to Friday, 8:00am to 5:00pm US Central (10:00pm to 7:00am Manila time from November to March; 9:00pm to 6:00am from March to November). Reports to Lisa Hu, Founder & CEO.



IF DISTRIBUTORS ASK FOR YOU BY NAME, READ ON

The best account coordinators in promo aren't the fastest to say yes. They're the ones distributors trust to tell them the truth: what it takes to hit the date, what it will cost, and what to pitch instead when the first idea won't work. Their clients come back because of them. We're looking for that person.



ABOUT LUX & NYX

Lux & Nyx designs architectural handbags for professional women who refuse to choose between style and function. Featured in Forbes, Refinery29, NPR, and Marie Claire. Our corporate gifting business runs through promotional-products distributors, who find us on ESP and SAGE and pitch our bags to their clients. Remote-first team led by founder Lisa Hu.



THE ROLE

You'll own our distributor relationships, working directly with our founder. You're the person they
 first: you answer the same day, send quotes they can trust, help them win their client's business, and follow every open quote until it's a yes or a no. When it's a yes, you run the order backward from its in-hand date, through proof approval, decoration, kitting, cartons, labels and shipping, so the order lands on time and they come back for the next one. Inside the team, you keep things moving: you run our internal meetings, follow up on every action item, and help Lisa turn recurring work into systems.



WHAT YOU'LL OWN

• Distributor relationships: be their go-to contact, learn their clients and their calendars, and keep them coming back.

• Inquiries and quotes: pricing, minimums, colorways, decoration options and lead times, checked against stock and the calendar before you commit to a date.

• Open quotes: every one tracked with a next step and the client's event date, followed up because a deadline is coming, not just because time has passed.

• Orders: re-check stock, pricing and timing before you confirm, and make sure the PO, the quote and the confirmation match.

• Backward planning: for every dated order, the date art must be approved, when the designer and decorator start, and when the warehouse kits and ships, with each party briefed in time.

• Pack-out and shipping: cartons and labels from our pack-out spec, counts confirmed with the warehouse, and a final check before anything ships.

• Team coordination: run our internal meetings with a clear agenda, notes and action items, then follow up with each owner until every item is closed.

• Systems for the founder: when Lisa asks, help her turn a recurring admin task into a system (an SOP, a template or an AI workflow) so it runs without her. You build the system; AI and the system do the admin.

• Backup for our operations teammate: cover listings, catalog updates and customer care when they're out on holiday or leave.

• SOPs: write down every step you own, so nothing lives in one person's head.



Not part of this role: cold outbound prospecting (our founder and sales consultant own that), managing people, doing Lisa's day-to-day admin (AI covers most of it), and day-to-day listings and customer care (our operations coordinator owns those; you cover when they're out).



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

• You stop rather than send. If a price, date or count doesn't add up, nothing goes out until it does. That's the number one thing.

• 3+ years as an account coordinator, order coordinator, CSR or sales support in promotional products, corporate gifting or wholesale, for a distributor, supplier or decorator.

• Real relationships with buyers: you're warm, confident and honest, and you can say "here's what it takes" instead of an easy yes.

• Orders that run for weeks across several outside parties: suppliers, decorators, warehouses and carriers.

• Organized enough to run a meeting: every item ends with an owner and a date, and you follow up until it's done.

• A builder: when something was never written down, you write it down and make it the standard, and you'd rather build a system than do the same task twice.

• Comfortable with AI tools and simple workflows: you use them to draft and automate, and the judgment stays yours.

• Hands-on with ESP, SAGE, commonsku or a similar promo system, or a CRM or pipeline tracker.

• Clear, polished English, written and spoken.

• Strong spreadsheet skills, with zero tolerance for a wrong price or spec going out.

• Here for the long haul: you want to own this work and get great at it.



A plus: listing, catalog or customer care work on ESP, SAGE, Amazon, Shopify or retailer portals, since you'll cover for our operations teammate. We'll train you on our process.



You don't need every box ticked. If distributors trust you, and you've planned a dated order backward and caught the number that didn't add up before it shipped, we want to hear from you.



WHAT GREAT LOOKS LIKE

• Distributors come back, and they ask for you.

• Every inquiry answered the same business day.

• Zero quotes sent with a wrong price, minimum or lead time.

• Every open quote has a next step, and none goes quiet without a decision.

• Every order lands by its in-hand date, with cartons, labels and packing list matching.

• Every meeting ends with owners and dates, and every action item closes.

• Every system you build keeps running without you or Lisa babysitting it.



PAY AND BENEFITS

US$900 to $1,300 a month depending on experience, plus a performance bonus. Paid PTO. Health stipend. Weekly 1:1 with Lisa, async-first on Slack.



HOW TO APPLY

Apply right here on OnlineJobs.ph. Your application must do three things:



1. Start with the word CLEAN.

2. In three sentences, tell us about an order with a hard deadline that you planned backward from: what had to happen when, and who you had to line up.

3. Include your resume, or a Google Drive link to it that opens.



Applications missing any of the three won't be reviewed. Those steps are deliberate: they show us, before we ever meet, whether you read carefully and own the details.



NEXT STEPS

If you're shortlisted: a recorded video intro (3 to 5 minutes), then a paid skills test based on real work ($20, about 4 hours), then an interview with our founder and a reference check.

title: AMAZON OPERATIONS VA (EUROPE)
description:
We are looking for an Amazon VA who sees problems coming.



The best people in this job do the hands-on work that keeps our listings live and selling. They notice the deal that was set up for the wrong week, the reimbursement window that closes on Friday and the listing that lost its main image overnight. They act on it before it costs us sales, they tell the team clearly what is happening, and when the usual fix does not work, they find another way.



If that sounds like how you already work, read on.



ABOUT US



We are a fast-growing European consumer brand selling home and kitchen appliances, cleaning products and children's toys. We sell on Amazon in 8 marketplaces (UK, Germany, France, Italy, Spain, Netherlands, Belgium and Poland), with more than 60 products on Pan-EU FBA and about 6 new launches a quarter from 2027. A small team runs all of this. Our Senior Brand Manager owns the strategy and the numbers. You own the operational work that makes it happen.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

Catalog and listings

- Create and maintain listings in all 8 marketplaces, mainly through flat files and bulk uploads

- Diagnose and fix listing errors, feed errors, search suppression, missing pages and stranded inventory

- Manage parent-child variations, variation themes and category attributes

- Upload titles, bullets, specifications, images, A+ content and videos, including seasonal changes

- Take new products from listing to live, including Vine enrollment and early review monitoring

- Apply price changes and minimum price limits, and check them after they go live

- Watch our listings for unwanted changes: edited titles or images, hijackers, other sellers on our ASINs, and report them through Brand Registry



Account health and compliance

- Monitor ODR, on-time delivery, late dispatch, valid tracking and policy compliance in every marketplace

- Resolve product safety, GPSR, dangerous goods and policy flags, using documents from our Quality and Compliance team

- Write and submit appeals for listing removals, investigations and IP complaints



FBA, fees and reimbursements

- Audit FBA fees and product dimensions, and open remeasurement cases when Amazon overcharges

- File and follow reimbursement claims for lost and damaged units, shipment discrepancies, storage fees and removal fees before the claim windows close

- Monitor Pan-EU enrollment, removal orders, stranded inventory and storage limits



Seller Support

- Open, follow up and escalate cases until the problem is actually fixed, not just until the case is closed

- Keep a record of case IDs, what was asked and what Amazon answered



PPC: you do the legwork

- The Senior Brand Manager sets the PPC strategy. You turn instructions into correct, checked changes in the Ads console, quickly and without supervision:

- Adjust bids by a set rule across one or many campaigns and marketplaces

- Build Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands and Sponsored Display campaigns from a brief, using bulk sheets for large changes

- Harvest search terms into exact-match campaigns, and add negative keywords and negative ASINs for wasted spend

- Pause and restart ads around deals, stockouts and launches, and confirm the next day that nothing spent when it should not have

- Pull Search Term, Targeting, Placement and Budget reports when the Senior Brand Manager asks for them

- Tell us when an instruction would cause a problem, for example a bid increase on a product that is about to go out of stock



Reporting and admin

- Keep your tasks up to date in ClickUp and share progress in Slack

- Log every change you make in Seller Central and the Ads console in our change diary

- Send a weekly report: what was fixed, what is still open, what is coming up, and the case IDs behind it

- Keep our step-by-step guides (SOPs) current when Amazon changes a page, a report or a policy



WHAT THIS ROLE DOES NOT COVER

Strategy, PPC strategy and reviewing financials such as sales, profit and margins (the Senior Brand Manager), inventory planning and shipments (our supply chain team), and designing images and videos (our content team). You will work closely with all three.



HOW YOU WORK: WHAT MATTERS MOST TO US

- You act before it becomes a problem

- You look ahead, not only at today.

- You do not wait for someone to assign a problem you have already seen. You start on it and tell us where it stands.

- When you fix something, you also ask why it happened and stop it from happening again.

- You communicate issues well

- You tell us early, not only when it is fixed. A good first message says what happened, which products and marketplaces are affected, what you are doing about it, what you need from us, and when you will update next.

- You write so nobody needs to ask a follow-up question. Short, specific, with the numbers and the case IDs.

- You say when something is wrong, even when it is your own mistake, and even when everything else looks fine.

- You close the loop. Nobody should have to ask twice for an update or repeat an instruction.

- You think outside the box

- When Seller Support gives the same wrong answer twice, you find another route: a different case type, new evidence, the account manager, a different marketplace's team.

- When a task is slow and repetitive, you find a faster way: a template, a bulk upload, a spreadsheet formula, an AI tool.

- You spot opportunities as well as problems, like a competitor that went out of stock or a deal we could join, and pass them to the Senior Brand Manager.

- When you are blocked, you move other work forward and come back to it. Nothing gets left behind.



WHAT WE NEED

- 3+ years of hands-on Seller Central work, with recent experience on EU marketplaces

- 1+ year of hands-on work in the Amazon Ads console: Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands and Sponsored Display, bulk sheets, search term reports, and the difference between ACOS, ROAS and TACOS

- Proven results in catalog work and account health. We will test both in the interview.

- Confident with flat files and Excel or Google Sheets, including lookups and pivot tables

- Careful with details: after every change, you check that it actually took effect in every marketplace

- Working knowledge of Pan-EU FBA and GPSR

- Excellent written English. You will write updates for our team and cases and appeals that Amazon has to take seriously.

- Comfortable working on listings in languages you do not speak, using translation tools, and knowing when a translation needs a native check



NICE TO HAVE

- Experience with Sellerboard, Keepa or Helium 10

- Regular use of AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini or similar) to work faster, with examples you can show us

- Consumer electronics or toy compliance (CE, UKCA, lithium battery documentation)



THE DETAILS

- Full time, Monday to Friday, 3:00 pm to 12:00 midnight Manila time (PHT), with a 1-hour break within the shift. Weekends off. These hours overlap the European working day.

- Paid monthly via Wise

- Own computer and stable internet required

- You will report directly to the Senior Brand Manager



HOW TO APPLY

ALL APPLICATIONS MUST BE SUBMITTED THROUGH THIS FORM:





We only review applications submitted through the form. Applications sent by
, direct message, comment or any other channel will not be reviewed, and we will not reply to them.



In the first question of the form, type the words "Before it breaks" so we know you read this far. The form then asks for your details and these five questions. Please write the answers yourself.

description:

Project: Entrepreneurship at Sea 2027

Location: Remote – Philippines-Based Freelancers Preferred

Employment Type: Independent Contractor / Fixed-Price Project

Total Project Budget: $500–$650 USD

Scheduled Start Date: Monday, January 4, 2027

Estimated Project Duration: 20–30 Working Days

Work Schedule: Monday–Friday, U.S. Eastern Time business hours

Primary Platform: GoHighLevel (GHL)

Domain Management: GoDaddy





IMPORTANT PROJECT START DATE



We are currently recruiting qualified freelancers for a project scheduled to begin Monday, January 4, 2027, after the holiday season.



If our company d
 to begin earlier, the selected freelancer will be notified in advance.



This is a fixed-price project. Payments will be tied to completed milestones, and unlimited revisions within the approved scope will be required until our company formally approves the deliverables.



Please review the entire description before applying.





ABOUT OUR COMPANY AND PROJECT



Mikey Adventures Travel by Cruise Planners is developing Entrepreneurship at Sea, a new international business networking cruise experience planned for 2027 aboard Virgin Voyages.



Our vision is to bring together approximately 250–400 entrepreneurs, CEOs, business owners, founders, executives, innovators, and thought leaders from around the world.



Entrepreneurship can sometimes feel lonely. We believe that surrounding yourself with like-minded people can make the journey more rewarding, exciting, and meaningful.



Our goal is to create an international community where participants can exchange ideas, discover new business opportunities, develop professional relationships, build genuine friendships, and support one another.



Our inaugural sailing will target a minimum of 250 registered networking participants, with the potential to welcome up to 400 guests, subject to confirmed cruise arrangements.



We hope to organize additional Entrepreneurship at Sea sailings in 2027 based on interest and the success of our inaugural voyage.



We need an experienced, reliable, and detail-oriented freelancer to build our complete digital infrastructure from scratch.



This includes website development, GoDaddy integration, GoHighLevel CRM configuration, reservation intake forms,
 and SMS automation, AI implementation, SEO, free PDF guide creation,
 advertising, guest tracking, and important communication workflows.



This is not simply a website design project. We need a professional system capable of supporting hundreds of international participants while providing a smooth and reliable guest experience.





1. COMPLETE WEBSITE DESIGN AND DEVELOPMENT



Build a brand-new website entirely inside GoHighLevel.



The website should reflect a premium international business networking experience.



Required website pages:



Homepage – Entrepreneurship at Sea 2027

About Entrepreneurship at Sea

Meet Your Host – Michael Turell

Why Entrepreneurship at Sea?

Who Should Attend?

Networking Activities and Experiences

Virgin Voyages Cruise Experience

Cabin Accommodations

Reservation Process

Important Guest Information

Frequently Asked Questions

Free Downloadable Guide

Join the Priority Interest List

Future Community and Alumni Opportunities

Contact Us

Privacy Policy and Terms and Conditions



Website requirements:



Professional design and branding

Mobile, tablet, and desktop responsiveness

Fast loading performance

Clear navigation

Professional copywriting

Strong calls to action

GoHighLevel lead capture forms

SEO-friendly page structure

 advertising tracking

Automated inquiry confirmations

Secure guest information collection

Appropriate privacy and consent mechanisms

Ability to add multiple future sailings



All website content, design, and functionality must receive company approval before launch.



Unconfirmed sailing dates, fares, venues, activities, availability, prizes, and promotional benefits must not be presented as guaranteed.





2. GODADDY DOMAIN AND GOHIGHLEVEL INTEGRATION



Experience connecting GoDaddy-managed domains to GoHighLevel websites is mandatory.



The freelancer must:



Connect our designated GoDaddy-managed domain to GoHighLevel.

Configure required DNS records.

Set up A records and CNAME records when applicable.

Verify SSL certificates and HTTPS functionality.

Configure www and non-www domain settings.

Set up redirects where necessary.

Publish the completed website under our designated domain.

Troubleshoot DNS and website connection problems.

Test website accessibility.

Preserve existing business
 settings.

Avoid disrupting existing websites and other business services.

Verify website and automation functionality after publishing.



The freelancer must understand MX, SPF, DKIM, and DMARC records and avoid unauthorized DNS changes that could disrupt
 delivery.



Our company will retain ownership and administrative control of the domain and website accounts.



GoDaddy integration must be included in the fixed project price.





3. MEET YOUR HOST – MICHAEL TURELL



Develop a professional website section introducing Michael Turell as the founder and host of Entrepreneurship at Sea.



The content should highlight his entrepreneurial background, experience in the travel industry, passion for connecting people, and inspiration for creating this experience.



Our message is that entrepreneurship should not have to be a lonely journey.



We want to encourage participants to step outside their comfort zones, meet people from different backgrounds, and create meaningful connections.





4. ENTREPRENEURSHIP AT SEA NETWORKING PROGRAM



We are currently developing our official onboard program.



The website should introduce the proposed experiences while clearly explaining that venues, scheduling, and activities remain subject to Virgin Voyages' approval.



WELCOME AND HOST INTRODUCTION



Michael Turell will welcome participants, introduce himself, share the vision behind Entrepreneurship at Sea, and explain why meaningful connections are important.



FIVE-MINUTE SPEED NETWORKING



We plan to organize structured networking activities where participants spend approximately five minutes introducing themselves, discussing their businesses, and exchanging contact information before rotating to meet someone new.



We are considering approximately 2–4 hours of networking, subject to venue availability and approval.



STEP OUTSIDE YOUR COMFORT ZONE



Entrepreneurship at Sea encourages participants to meet new people independently.



Couples, friends, and traveling companions who are registered participants will be encouraged to network separately during structured sessions.



Our goal is to help participants build connections outside their existing social circles.



BUSINESS CARD NETWORKING



Participants will be encouraged to bring approximately 400–600 business cards or digital business card alternatives.



We may request two physical business cards for potential giveaways.



GIVEAWAYS AND PRIZES



Potential prizes may include:



Complimentary Virgin Voyages cruise

Amazon gift cards

Cheesecake Factory gift cards

Other sponsored prizes



All prizes are subject to confirmation, availability, and official promotional rules.



Participants may be required to be present during designated networking sessions to claim prizes.



If a selected winner does not respond within 30 seconds, an alternate participant may be selected according to the official rules.



NETWORKING BEYOND THE VOYAGE



We want guests to continue building relationships after the sailing.



We may offer an optional professional networking directory.



Only participants who explicitly agree to share their professional contact information will be included.



The finalized networking schedule and program information will be
ed approximately 30 days before departure.





5. RESERVATION INTAKE FORM



The reservation intake form is one of the most important components of the website.



All prospective participants must submit accurate information before our agency can prepare their reservations.



All Entrepreneurship at Sea reservations must be coordinated through Michael Turell of Mikey Adventures Travel by Cruise Planners.



The official Virgin Voyages itinerary may be linked for informational purposes, but guests must coordinate their hosted group reservations through our agency.



Required intake fields:



First name

Last name

 address

Telephone number

Home address

Number of travelers

Preferred cabin category

Solo traveler or traveling with a companion

Whether a companion will participate in networking events

Travel protection selection

Acknowledgment of payment policies

Confirmation that every traveler will be at least 18 years old at sailing



The system must securely collect and organize the required information for each participating guest.



All intake form responses must be saved in GoHighLevel.



Incomplete forms must be flagged for follow-up.





6. CABIN CATEGORIES AND ROOMMATE POLICY



Entrepreneurship at Sea will not provide roommate matching or assign participants to share cabins.



Guests must indicate their preferred accommodation category during intake.



Potential options:



Solo accommodations, if available

Sea Terrace balcony cabins

RockStar Suites

Mega RockStar Suites



Guests may travel alone or bring their own companion.



Virgin Voyages fares are often based on double occupancy.



A guest occupying a double-occupancy cabin alone may pay close to the total fare of a cabin shared by two guests.



Actual pricing depends on the sailing, cabin category, promotions, and availability.



We cannot guarantee a fixed price difference between solo and double occupancy.



We strongly encourage guests to consider a Sea Terrace balcony cabin to enjoy the Virgin Voyages signature hammock experience, where available.



Guests seeking additional amenities may consider RockStar and Mega RockStar suites.



All prices and cabin availability must be verified before a reservation is created.





7. TRAVELING WITH COMPANIONS



Guests may bring spouses, partners, friends, and family members aboard Virgin Voyages.



Traveling companions do not need to be entrepreneurs or business owners.



However, private Entrepreneurship at Sea networking activities are reserved for approved, registered program participants.



Unregistered companions will not be permitted to attend private group sessions.



Registered couples and friends will be encouraged to participate independently during networking activities.



Guests will have plenty of time outside our group schedule to enjoy the cruise with their companions.



These requirements must be explained clearly on the website and intake form.





8. TRAVEL PROTECTION SELECTION



The reservation intake form must ask whether guests wish to review available travel insurance or protection options.



Required choices:



Yes, please provide available travel protection options and pricing.

No, I decline travel protection.



We strongly recommend considering travel insurance because unexpected circumstances may include medical emergencies, trip cancellations, interruptions, baggage issues, and other unforeseen situations.



When a guest selects YES:



Record the selection in GoHighLevel.

Notify our agency.

Allow our team to present applicable coverage and pricing.

Obtain the guest's approval before adding or purchasing coverage.

Record the final protection status.



When a guest selects NO:



Record their decision.

Do not automatically add travel protection.



The CRM should distinguish between requested, declined, pending authorization, and confirmed protection.



Coverage and benefits depend on the applicable policy terms, eligibility, and exclusions.





9. LIMITED CABIN AVAILABILITY AND RESERVATION POLICY



IMPORTANT: LIMITED CABIN INVENTORY



Entrepreneurship at Sea will have a limited number of accommodations available for participating guests.



Because our goal is to bring together approximately 250–400 participants, reservation deadlines must be managed carefully.



We must act promptly to ensure available cabins are not held indefinitely without payment.



Once a prospective guest completes the reservation intake form, our agency will review the information and verify the applicable cabin availability.



If accommodation is available, we will prepare the reservation through the authorized Cruise Planners and Virgin Voyages booking process.



The guest will receive an
 containing an official secure payment link and reservation instructions.



24-HOUR PAYMENT DEADLINE



Guests will have 24 hours from the time the official payment link is
ed to complete the required deposit or pay the reservation in full, subject to the applicable cruise line booking terms.



If payment is not received within the stated timeframe, the reservation will be subject to cancellation and the cabin may be released.



PAYMENT OPTIONS



Guests will be able to choose between paying the required deposit or paying their reservation in full, where both options are permitted by the reservation terms.



If the guest chooses the deposit option, the remaining cruise balance must be paid no later than 120 days before sailing, or by any earlier deadline stated in the confirmed reservation.



Reservations created within the final payment period may require immediate full payment.



ONE-TIME RESERVATION DO-OVER



We understand that life happens and unexpected circumstances may prevent guests from meeting their initial deposit deadline.



For this reason, we will permit one reservation do-over.



If the original reservation is canceled because payment was not completed within 24 hours, the guest may request one opportunity to have a new reservation created.



Approval will depend on current cabin availability, pricing, and applicable booking terms.



If approved, the guest will receive a new payment link with one final 24-hour deadline.



If payment is not received within the second deadline and the reservation is canceled again, the guest will be withdrawn from Entrepreneurship at Sea for that sailing.



No further reservation do-overs will be permitted.



The original fare, cabin category, promotional offers, and availability cannot be guaranteed when a reservation is recreated.



IMPORTANT GUEST COMMUNICATION



This policy must be clearly communicated:



On the website

On the intake form

In the free PDF guide

In reservation confirmation
s

In payment link notifications

In payment reminder
s

In the FAQ section



Guests must acknowledge the payment deadlines and cancellation policy before submitting their intake form.





10. GOHIGHLEVEL RESERVATION AUTOMATION



The freelancer must build automated workflows to support our reservation process.



Required functionality:



Record the reservation creation date.

Record when the payment link
 is sent.

Calculate the applicable 24-hour payment deadline.

Send the reservation payment
.

Send an automatic reminder before the deadline.

Track whether payment has been verified.

Flag unpaid reservations for agency review and cancellation.

Track whether a guest has requested or used a one-time do-over.

Send updated payment instructions.

13. PRIVATE

We will create a private
 group for each Entrepreneurship at Sea sailing.



Only registered networking participants whose final payments have been verified will qualify for invitations.



Invitations will be distributed approximately 30 days before sailing.



The freelancer must:



Track the sailing date.

Track verified final payment status.

Schedule invitation
s.

Exclude guests with outstanding balances.

Send invitations to eligible guests who complete payment after the initial invitation date.

Support a verification and approval process for group membership.

title: Part-time Cold Caller / Appointment Setter for US Web Design Company
description:
About us

Jobsite Web Co. builds websites for trade businesses in San Diego County: electricians, plumbers, HVAC, roofers, landscapers and more. The owner, Corey, is a working electrician himself. We're small and growing.



The job

You call small contractor businesses from a list we give you. Every name comes with a short, true reason to call (for example, they just got their contractor license and don't show up on Google yet). Your goal is to book a short meeting or call between the business owner and Corey. You do not sell, quote special prices or close deals. Corey does that.



Hours and pay

- 20 hours a week: Monday to Friday, one fixed 4-hour block during US Pacific business hours (Philippines night shift).

- $5 USD per hour.

- Bonus: $100 USD every time a business you booked pays its deposit to start a website.

- Paid weekly by Wise, every Friday, for hours already worked. No pay in advance.

- Starts with a 2-week paid trial.



You'll be a great fit if you

- Have 6+ months of cold calling experience with US businesses or homeowners (real estate, solar, insurance, B2B all count)

- Speak clear, natural English and sound relaxed, not scripted

- Show up for every shift on time, and tell us at least 24 hours ahead if you can't

- Stay friendly when people say no

- Keep accurate notes, including spelling every
 address correctly

- Have a quiet place to work, a headset, reliable internet and a backup if it goes down



What we provide

- The call list and script

- Your own login to our US business phone line

- A shared sheet to log every call

- Feedback from Corey after your first shifts



How to apply

1. Tell us about your cold calling experience in 3 to 5 sentences: what you called for, how many calls a day, and your best result.

2. Send a voice recording (under 1 minute) reading this out loud as if you were on a real call:

"Hey, is this Mike? Hey Mike, it's [your name] calling for Corey at Jobsite Web Co. Honestly, this is a cold call. Can I tell you why I picked you, and you can hang up if it's not a fit? Congrats on your new contractor license. Right now when someone Googles Ace Plumbing, nothing comes up, so those calls go to whoever does show up."

3. Tell us which 4-hour block, in US Pacific time, you can work every weekday.

4. Put the word "TOOLBELT" at the top of your application so we know you read this far.



Applications without the voice recording won't be reviewed.

title: Insurance Claims Specialist/ Xactimate Estimator
description:
Job Overview



Roofing Knights is seeking a highly organized, detail-oriented, and experienced **Insurance Claims Specialist & Xactimate Estimator** to support our residential roofing insurance claims operations.



The ideal candidate will have strong experience in Xactimate estimating, insurance claim documentation, supplement preparation, and communication with insurance adjusters.



This position focuses primarily on **claims administration, estimating, supplement preparation, and insurance carrier coordination**. Direct homeowner communication is not a regular responsibility and will only be required when specifically authorized by management.



The candidate must also be proficient in 
 CRM, Google Workspace, and digital roofing measurement and documentation tools.



## Key Responsibilities



**1. Insurance Claims Management**

- Manage and monitor roofing insurance claims from initial filing through final settlement and payment.

- Review insurance estimates, claim documents, scopes of loss, depreciation, deductibles, and payment summaries.

- Identify missing items, underpaid line items, and discrepancies between insurance estimates and documented roof damage.

- Track claim progress, pending supplements, approvals, and outstanding insurance payments.

- Coordinate internally with project managers, field inspectors, and management regarding claim requirements.



**2. Xactimate Estimating & Supplements**

- Prepare accurate, detailed Xactimate estimates using current local pricing, roofing materials, labor, and applicable waste factors.

- Review and compare insurance carrier estimates against contractor estimates and documented field conditions.

- Prepare and submit supplements supported by roof measurements, photographs, building codes, and material specifications.

- Identify missing roofing components, including underlayment, flashing, ventilation, decking, and other applicable items.

- Review aerial roof measurement reports from EagleView, Roofr, and similar platforms.



**3. Insurance Adjuster Coordination**

- Communicate professionally with insurance adjusters and claim representatives regarding estimates, supplements, documentation, and claim status.

- Follow up on pending supplement approvals, revised estimates, and insurance payment releases.

- Address scope discrepancies and provide supporting documentation to justify requested adjustments.

- Escalate disputed or unresolved claim matters to management when necessary.

- Maintain complete records of insurance communications and claim-related correspondence.



**4. 
 CRM Management**

- Proficiently navigate and utilize 
 CRM for daily claims management.

- Update claim statuses, assigned tasks, follow-up schedules, and project progress.

- Upload and organize insurance estimates, supplement documents, photographs, and related claim files.

- Monitor deadlines, pending approvals, and outstanding insurance payments.

- Maintain accurate, organized, and up-to-date project records for management review.



**5. Google Workspace & Administrative Coordination**

- Proficient in Gmail, Google Drive, Google Docs, and Google Sheets.

- Prepare, send, and respond to professional
s using company Google Workspace accounts.

- Organize and manage electronic claim documents, estimates, and supporting files.

- Maintain clear written communication with insurance companies, adjusters, and internal team members.

- Prepare claim summaries, progress updates, and reports as requested by management.



**6. Roofing Documentation & Code Research**

- Review roof inspection reports, damage assessments, and photographic documentation.

- Understand California roofing installation standards, applicable building codes, and manufacturer requirements.

- Identify documentation needed to support roofing insurance supplements.

- Coordinate with field personnel to obtain missing photographs, measurements, and other supporting evidence.



## Required Qualifications



- **Experience:** Minimum 2 years of professional experience in US property insurance claims estimating, preferably residential roofing.

- **Xactimate:** Advanced proficiency in preparing, reviewing, and revising estimates and supplements.

- **Insurance Knowledge:** Strong understanding of US insurance claim procedures, RCV, ACV, recoverable depreciation, deductibles, and supplement processing.

- **CRM Experience:** Practical experience using 
 CRM, including navigation, status updates, task management, file organization, and reporting.

- **Google Workspace:** Proficiency in Gmail, Google Drive, Google Docs, and Google Sheets.

- **Roof Measurements:** Familiarity with EagleView, Roofr, or similar aerial roof measurement platforms.

- **Communication:** Strong written and verbal English skills, particularly for professional correspondence with insurance adjusters.

- **Organization:** Ability to manage multiple active insurance claims, meet deadlines, and maintain accurate records with minimal supervision.



## Preferred Qualifications



- Xactimate Level 2 or Level 3 certification.

- Previous experience working with US roofing contractors or insurance restoration companies.

- Strong knowledge of California residential roofing construction codes and industry terminology.

- Experience preparing insurance supplements involving roof decking, underlayment, flashing, ventilation, and code-required items.

- Familiarity with CompanyCam or similar field documentation platforms.



## Important Role Expectations



- This is primarily an **insurance estimating and claims coordination position**, not a homeowner-facing customer service role.

- Homeowner communication regarding insurance coverage, policy benefits, or claim settlement matters must be authorized by management.

- All estimates, supplements, and claim-related documentation must be accurate, properly supported, and submitted through approved company procedures.

- Claim negotiations and settlement-related matters must remain within the employee's authorized responsibilities and applicable laws and regulations.

- Consistent CRM updates, professional
 communication, and timely follow-ups are essential.

title: Customer Follow-Up & Scheduling Specialist (Fluent English Required)
description:
Hiring: Experienced Customer Service & Appointment Setting Specialist (Remote)



Company: Chuck’s Flooring

Location: Remote – Philippines

Industry: Home Improvement / Flooring

Position: Customer Service Representative (CSR) & Appointment Setter



About Chuck’s Flooring



Chuck’s Flooring is a growing, family-owned flooring company serving homeowners in South Carolina and North Carolina.



We’re looking for a skilled, confident, and results-driven Customer Service Representative who knows how to turn incoming inquiries into qualified appointments.



This is not a basic customer support position. We’re looking for someone who understands sales psychology, communicates naturally with American customers, and knows how to guide conversations toward booking without being pushy.



Your Responsibilities



* Contact new leads promptly after they submit an inquiry.

* Follow up with existing leads in our CRM pipeline.

* Handle inbound and outbound calls, text messages, and customer communication.

* Build rapport with homeowners and confidently guide them toward scheduling an estimate.

* Schedule appointments at our designated time slots:

    * 9:00 AM

    * 12:00 PM

    * 3:00 PM

    * 6:00 PM (Monday–Friday)

* Maintain consistent follow-up with unresponsive leads:

    * Up to 3 attempts daily during the first 30 days.

    * 1 attempt daily during the second month.

* Keep accurate customer notes, follow-up records, and appointment statuses.

* Qualify projects before scheduling to ensure our sales representatives are meeting with the right homeowners.



What Makes an Appointment Qualified?



We value quality over quantity.



A qualified appointment means:



* The homeowner is genuinely interested in flooring installation or replacement.

* The project matches the services Chuck’s Flooring offers.

* The customer is seeking an actual flooring project, not small handyman repairs.

* The homeowner understands the purpose of the in-home estimate and agrees to the appointment.

* The customer is available and prepared to discuss their flooring needs.



Who We’re Looking For



Required Qualifications:



* Excellent spoken and written English, with clear, natural communication.

* Strong phone confidence and professional customer service skills.

* Experience in outbound calling, appointment setting, or sales.

* Ability to handle objections and hesitant customers professionally.

* A proactive, persuasive, and customer-focused communication style.

* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

* Ability to work independently and maintain consistent follow-ups.

* Reliable internet connection, a quiet workspace, and dependable availability.



Preferred Qualifications:



* Experience working with US-based businesses or American customers.

* Background in home improvement, home services, or related industries.

* Experience using CRM software such as GoHighLevel.

* Proven success booking appointments or converting inbound leads.

* Familiarity with consultative selling and relationship-based sales techniques.



Compensation & Opportunities



* Competitive compensation based on experience and qualifications.

* Performance-based booking bonuses for qualified appointments scheduled.

* Opportunities for growth as our company continues expanding.

* Established systems, organized lead pipelines, and ongoing support.



Systems & Training Provided



You’ll have access to our customer management and communication systems, allowing you to call, text, track leads, and manage follow-ups efficiently.



We provide structured training on our services, qualification standards, appointment process, and customer communication expectations.



We’re looking for someone who already has strong communication and sales fundamentals and can quickly learn our processes.



What Makes Someone Successful Here?



The best candidate doesn’t simply read a script or make calls to hit a number.



They know how to listen, ask thoughtful questions, understand customer needs, handle hesitation, and make homeowners feel comfortable taking the next step.



We want someone who takes ownership of their results and understands that consistent, professional follow-up drives appointments.



How to Apply



To demonstrate attention to detail, please begin your application with the word “Flooring”.



1. Tell us about your phone-based experience.



Have you handled inbound calls, outbound calls, appointment setting, or sales? What types of customers or industries have you worked with?



2. How would you handle this objection?



A homeowner says:



“I’m just looking right now. I’m not ready to schedule anything yet.”



Explain how you would respond naturally and professionally to move the conversation forward.



3. What makes an appointment qualified?



Explain how you determine whether a homeowner is genuinely interested and ready for an in-home flooring estimate.



4. Share your previous results.



If you have appointment-setting experience, tell us approximately how many calls you handled daily, how many appointments you scheduled, and how you measured success.



5. Submit a 2–3 minute voice recording.



Pretend you’re calling an American homeowner who just submitted an online flooring inquiry.



Introduce yourself, explain the reason for your call, ask relevant questions, and naturally guide the homeowner toward scheduling an estimate.



Applications without a voice recording will not be considered.



⸻



We’re looking for experienced professionals who want to grow with a company, deliver excellent customer experiences, and take pride in their results.

This is a casual role to start, with the intention to evolve into a full-time position for the right person.

We’re looking for someone who is technically capable, communicates clearly and enjoys solving problems in a collaborative, evolving environment.



The role will also contribute to AI-enabled features and automation, as well as using AI-assisted development tools to support coding, testing and documentation. You will help turn agreed requirements into practical solutions under our Senior Developer’s guidance.



Your role will involve:

• Working closely with our Senior Developer to understand the platform’s architecture, functionality and integrations.

• Applying secure development practices and protecting source code, credentials and sensitive information.

• Sharing knowledge and contributing to continuous improvement within our international team.



Technical Environment: 



You will work within our internal development team, following the technical direction of our Senior Developer and collaborating with our Technical Project Manager on priorities and delivery. 

Our technical environment includes:

• Frontend: Vue.js - Single Page Application framework.

• Backend: Laravel and PHP.

• Cloud Infrastructure: AWS, including ECS and containerisation.

• Integrations: RESTful APIs and third-party services.

• Development and Deployment: Git, automated testing and CI/CD pipelines.

• AI Development: AI-assisted coding tools and AI service or large language model API integrations, according to product requirements.

  

You have (selection criteria): 



• At least 3 years’ experience in full-stack web development.

• Solid hands-on experience with Vue.js and Laravel, including developing and maintaining existing applications.

• Experience working with RESTful APIs, relational databases, Git and collaborative development workflows.

• Practical experience using AI tools in software development, with the ability to review, test and explain the code you deliver.

• An understanding of how AI services can be integrated into web applications. Experience building AI-enabled features or workflow automation would be an advantage.

• Experience with automated testing and an understanding of secure coding practices.

• Familiarity with AWS, containerisation and CI/CD pipelines.

• Strong communication skills and a collaborative approach to working in a remote team.

• A proactive, solution-focused mindset and confidence asking questions or raising concerns.

• The ability to manage multiple priorities, meet agreed commitments and adapt as requirements evolve.

 

About DVE  

  

• We know Education! We specialise and care about making a difference in this sector.   

• We work on a wide range of interesting projects and provide outcomes that make a difference.  

• We enjoy flexible work practices with our clients and team around Australia and internationally.  

• We offer the ability to develop your own role and career path as we embark on our next stage of growth together.   

• We have a friendly, collaborative and flexible work environment.  

• Our Values are: We practice what we preach | We maintain client focus | We work as one team | We enjoy what we do!  

• We are recognised in our sector and community with awards such as Telstra Business Awards, Cool Company and more  

• Salary package including base salary and bonus structure commensurate with experience and mutual expectations in the role.    

  

Our projects across the sector cover three business lines:

• Student Success & Operational Excellence - helping institutions improve student journeys, strengthen administration and deliver more effective services and processes.

• Governance, Compliance & Risk - supporting institutions with regulatory requirements, governance, quality assurance and risk management.

• Digital & AI Transformation - helping institutions improve how they work through digital solutions, AI and automation, including our own placements management system.

 

NEXT STEP



Please submit your resume and a short application letter outlining how your experience meets the selection criteria.



Include examples of your Laravel and Vue.js work and explain your contribution to those projects. Tell us how you use AI in software development and, where applicable, describe an AI integration or automation you have helped build.

Position: Experienced Personal Injury Paralegal

Location: 100% Remote



Schedule: Full-Time, 40 Hours Per Week



Starting Salary: $1100 USD Per Month

Requirements – PLEASE READ BEFORE APPLYING

We are NOT looking for a case manager, legal assistant, or paralegal assistant.



A case manager's responsibilities are different from those of a litigation paralegal. Please apply only if you have real, hands-on paralegal experience.



2. Must Know Court Procedures and Filing Rules



You must have working knowledge of court procedures, deadlines, document preparation, and electronic filing requirements in at least ONE of the following states:



California



Nevada



Arizona

This is not an entry-level position. We expect you to already know how to perform the essential responsibilities of a litigation paralegal.



You must be comfortable preparing legal documents, managing litigation deadlines, handling court filings, and following applicable procedural rules without step-by-step training.

This is an exclusive, full-time position. You may NOT simultaneously work for another law firm or legal employer.



Any undisclosed outside legal employment, misrepresentation of working hours, or misuse of confidential firm information will be treated as a serious breach of your employment agreement and may result in immediate termination and appropriate legal action, including referral to authorities where criminal conduct is suspected.



5. Commitment, Accountability, and Professionalism



We value employees who take ownership of their responsibilities, meet deadlines, communicate effectively, and genuinely care about the quality of their work.



Why Join Us?



Edvin Jones Injury Law is growing rapidly, and we want people who will grow alongside the firm.



We believe in rewarding dedication, reliability, and excellent performance. After six months, you will be eligible for a performance review and consideration for promotion and increased compensation.



We are not looking for someone who simply wants another remote job. We are looking for someone who wants to become a valuable, long-term member of our team.

, please identify which state's court rules and filing procedures you have experience with (CA, NV, or AZ).

title: Social Media Manager & Strategist (AI-Savvy)
description:
NOW HIRING: Social Media Manager & Strategist (AI-Savvy)



Remote | Part-Time | Flexible Hours



ABOUT US



Queen Clean is a growing commercial and residential cleaning company based in Bozeman, Montana, USA.



We're looking for a creative, proactive, and results-driven Social Media Manager & Strategist to help strengthen our online presence, grow our audience, and improve our overall social media footprint.



We're not just looking for someone who can create pretty graphics or schedule posts. We want someone who understands social media strategy, account management, analytics, a local audience, and how to turn creative ideas into measurable results.



We're especially interested in someone who has experience working with U.S.-based businesses and knows how to leverage AI tools to improve marketing, content creation, and overall social media marketing impact.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



Social Media Management & Strategy



• Develop and implement social media strategies aligned with our business goals.

• Manage social media accounts, including content planning, scheduling, publishing, and performance monitoring.

• Identify opportunities to improve brand awareness, audience engagement, and growth.

• Research trends, competitors, and creative marketing opportunities.



Content Creation & AI Integration



• Create engaging graphics, captions, reels, and short-form video content.

• Maintain a consistent brand identity and voice across platforms.

• Use AI tools to improve creativity, productivity, and marketing workflows.

• Explore new content ideas and creative approaches relevant to our local market.



Analytics & Performance



• Monitor social media analytics and track relevant performance metrics.

• Identify what works, what needs improvement, and why.

• Provide clear performance updates and actionable recommendations.

• Continuously refine strategies based on actual data and results.



Team Collaboration



• Collaborate with Queen Clean's owner and management team.

• Participate in scheduled Google Meet co-working and strategy sessions.

• Communicate progress, share ideas, and provide recommendations proactively.

• Manage deadlines and follow through on agreed priorities.



IDEAL CANDIDATE



• Minimum of 2 years of professional social media management and marketing experience with U.S.-based businesses or clients, either within a company or as an independent contractor.

• Demonstrated ownership of social media strategy, execution, performance, and measurable results.

• Platform Expertise: Demonstrated experience managing business accounts across major platforms, including
, Instagram, LinkedIn, and TikTok, as applicable.

• Content Planning and Execution: Experience developing and managing content calendars, writing engaging copy, coordinating creative assets, scheduling posts, and maintaining consistent brand messaging.

• Performance Optimization: Ability to interpret analytics, identify opportunities, and proactively adjust strategies to improve reach, engagement, traffic, and conversions.

• Community Management: Experience monitoring comments, messages, and audience engagement while maintaining a professional brand voice.

• Marketing Tools: Proficiency with social media scheduling, publishing, reporting, and content creation tools.

• Portfolio: Strong portfolio showing previous work, managed accounts, and actual analytics or performance results.

• Social Media Strategy: Experience developing social media strategies, not just creating content.

• Analytics and Reporting: Familiarity with social media analytics and performance reporting.

• AI Proficiency: Knowledge of AI tools and their practical applications in marketing.

• Communication Skills: Excellent written English and understanding of U.S. audiences.

• Professional Attributes: Creative, detail-oriented, organized, and reliable.

• Independence and Initiative: Proactive, resourceful, and comfortable working independently.

• Collaboration: Comfortable collaborating in real time through Google Meet.



Nice to Have:



• Experience creating AI avatars or AI-generated videos.

• Experience marketing local service-based businesses.

• Experience with AI-assisted video editing and content creation.



WORK SCHEDULE & AVAILABILITY



This is a remote, part-time position with flexible hours.



Much of the work can be completed independently. However, we're looking for someone who can provide some consistent availability during our Montana business hours:



9:00 AM–5:00 PM Mountain Time (Montana, USA)



You do not need to work the entire 9–5 schedule.



However, you must be comfortable joining scheduled Google Meet co-working sessions to collaborate, discuss strategies, review performance, and work together on marketing initiatives.



Clear communication, reliability, and the ability to work collaboratively are important to us.



OPPORTUNITY FOR GROWTH



We're looking for someone who wants more than just another short-term project.



This position will begin as part-time, with the possibility of expanding as Queen Clean continues to grow.



We value creativity, initiative, accountability, and someone who genuinely enjoys helping a small business succeed.



HOW TO APPLY



If you're interested in joining our team, please complete our application form:







In your OnlineJobs.ph application message, please briefly answer the following questions:



1. Why are you interested in this role, and what makes you a strong fit?

2. Which social media management, design, scheduling, and analytics tools have you used?

3. Which responsibilities have you personally handled (strategy, content creation, publishing, reporting, account management, advertising, etc.)?

4. What AI tools have you used professionally for social media marketing, and how do you use them?

5. If you managed social media for a cleaning company in Bozeman, what would you prioritize during your first 30 days?



WHAT TO EXPECT DURING OUR INTERVIEW PROCESS



As part of our interview process, candidates should be prepared to share and discuss:



• Portfolio and Work Examples: Social media accounts you've managed, content you've created, and strategies you've developed.

• Organic Performance: Actual metrics demonstrating results, such as reach, engagement, audience growth, website traffic, and conversions.

• Campaign Performance: Examples of campaigns you've managed, including objectives, execution, performance metrics, and outcomes.

• Strategy and Decision Making: Your role in developing strategies, evaluating performance, and making adjustments to improve results.

• Professional References: Please be prepared to provide 2–3 professional references from previous clients or employers if you advance to the next stages of our hiring process.



We're interested in understanding not just the work you've produced, but the results you've achieved and your direct contribution to those outcomes.



IMPORTANT APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS



Please include the keyword QUEEN somewhere in your OnlineJobs.ph application message.



APPLICATIONS WILL BE AUTOMATICALLY DISQUALIFIED IF:



• The required Google Form has not been completed and submitted.

• The keyword QUEEN cannot be found in your OnlineJobs.ph application message.



Both requirements must be met for your application to be considered.



We value attention to detail, initiative, and candidates who carefully follow instructions.



We look forward to learning more about you! 💜



Queen Clean | Bozeman, Montana, USA

description:
SENIOR FULL-STACK AI ENGINEER, CREATOR PLATFORM



BOSS MGMT GRP | Full-time | Remote | Long-term



Only apply if you have built software for an influencer marketing platform or agency. Applications without a specific example will not be reviewed.



ABOUT US

BOSS MGMT GRP is a creator economy and brand partnerships group. We manage 400+ creators across YouTube, Instagram and TikTok.



We are building our own operating system to replace HubSpot and run the entire business: creator discovery, outreach, onboarding, rosters, media kits, brand CRM, contracting, campaign fulfilment and automation. The foundations are in place and running on real data, but there’s still a lot to build. We need a senior engineer who has done this before to help us finish it.



THE ROLE

You will work alongside the developer who built the platform, our in-house full-stack developer, and both directors. You report to the directors day-to-day. You will have a real say in architecture.



YOUR FIRST 90 DAYS

- Assess the architecture. Review the codebase and data model and deliver a written assessment by day 30: what is solid and what is fragile.

- Get outreach live. Fix contact enrichment, finish the review-and-approve flow, and switch on in-platform
 sequences with deliverability done properly.

- Land the HubSpot transition. Migrate creators, brands and deals into the platform, with clean deduplication and suppression so signed creators never receive cold outreach. HubSpot is switched off in April 2027.

- After that: campaign fulfilment and contracting, plus deals, finance and reporting.



MUST-HAVES

- Hands-on engineering experience on an influencer marketing or creator sponsorship platform, or building in-house tools for an influencer agency. For example, platforms such as Faved, ThoughtLeaders, InfluencerFunds, Agentio or similar.

- 5+ years of full-stack experience with TypeScript, React/Next.js, and PostgreSQL.

- You have run a CRM or large data migration end-to-end: mapping, deduplication, parallel run, cutover.

- You have shipped LLM features in production (drafting, classification, enrichment, retrieval) and know how to keep them accurate and auditable.

- YouTube Data API and YouTube Analytics API experience, including OAuth and quota management.

- Queue and background job architecture for scraping, enrichment and scheduled runs.

- You use AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor or similar) daily, and can still explain and defend every line you ship.

- Clear written and spoken English. You can explain technical trade-offs to non-technical directors.



STRONGLY PREFERRED

- HubSpot API and data model experience.

- Instagram Graph API and TikTok API experience.

-
 infrastructure: Resend or similar, SPF / DKIM / DMARC, warm-up, suppression, sender reputation.

- Integrations with PandaDoc, Xero or payment platforms.

- You have built campaign fulfilment workflows: deal tracking, deliverables, approvals, reporting to brands.

- You have set up Claude or similar AI tools for a non-technical team: projects, connectors, skills and automations that people use every day.



OUR STACK

- Next.js on Vercel, Neon PostgreSQL with Prisma, Vercel Blob, Vercel Cron and service queues, Anthropic Claude API, Resend, Gmail API, HubSpot API. Planned: PandaDoc, Xero, Airwallex.



TERMS

- Full-time independent contractor, engaged by BOSS MGMT GRP HOLDINGS LIMITED.

- Three-month paid trial at your full rate, with a checkpoint on day 30. Ongoing engagement after that.

- Philippines preferred. Southeast Asia and India also considered.

- Working hours start at 9 am Manila time, with daily overlap with our Australian and European team.

- Side work is fine as long as it doesn’t conflict and isn’t in the influencer marketing space.

- Start as soon as possible.



A NOTE ON CONFIDENTIALITY

We are hiring for your skills and experience. We do not want, and will not ask for, any confidential information, code or data belonging to a former employer or client.



HOW TO APPLY

 your application to CEO Michael Harris 
 and Director Blake Jenkins 
 both in the same
.

Answer all six questions in the

title: Track & Trace – Quality Assurance Team Lead (Brokerage Operations)
description:
GH Logistics is a growing US-based freight brokerage and asset-based logistics company specializing in dry van and reefer freight. Our operations are built on strong systems, clear communication, accountability, and reliable execution.



We're looking for an experienced, detail-oriented, and results-driven Track & Trace Quality Assurance Team Lead to oversee our QA operations, lead a team of remote associates, and ensure every booked load is properly verified before pickup. This is a hands-on leadership position for someone with strong US freight brokerage experience, sound operational judgment, and the ability to hold a team accountable in a fast-paced environment.



If you have experience managing logistics operations, identifying freight fraud risks, resolving escalations, and driving team performance, we'd like to hear from you.



Role Overview

Every day, GH Logistics books trucks to move freight across the United States. Before those trucks pick up, our Quality Assurance team verifies that the assigned drivers are legitimate, qualified, properly documented, and prepared to execute their loads.



As the Quality Assurance Team Lead, you will be responsible for overseeing the team's daily workload, monitoring verification progress, reviewing operational accuracy, and ensuring that no critical verification steps are overlooked. You will serve as the primary point of escalation for unresolved driver verification issues, suspicious carrier activity, tracking discrepancies, and operational concerns that could affect pickup performance or shipment security.



Beyond supervising the team, you are expected to remain actively involved in operations, make timely decisions, identify process gaps, and ensure consistent execution of established SOPs. This is a working leadership role, not solely an administrative or supervisory position. You must be comfortable stepping into operational tasks, handling difficult situations, and taking ownership of your team's results.



What You'll Be Doing



Team Leadership & Daily Operations

• Lead and supervise the Quality Assurance team, ensuring all assigned next-day loads are reviewed and verified before pickup.

• Distribute workloads based on shipment volume, urgency, team capacity, and operational priorities.

• Monitor individual and team productivity, task completion, verification accuracy, and overall performance.

• Ensure team members consistently follow established SOPs, verification procedures, and documentation standards.

• Provide real-time guidance, coaching, and corrective feedback to improve individual and team performance.

• Identify performance gaps, recurring errors, and accountability concerns, and escalate them to management when necessary.

• Maintain clear shift handovers, ensuring pending verifications, unresolved issues, and critical follow-ups are properly communicated.

• Take ownership of daily QA execution and ensure operational priorities are completed without unnecessary delays.



Load Verification, Quality Control & Fraud Prevention

• Oversee the verification process for booked loads, ensuring rate confirmations are sent to the correct carriers.

• Ensure driver information, carrier details, and load assignments are complete, accurate, and properly documented.

• Review CDL verification results and ensure required identity verification procedures are followed.

• Monitor compliance with driver check calls, tracking assignments, and pre-pickup verification requirements.

• Conduct quality checks and spot audits to identify incomplete verifications, documentation errors, and procedural violations.

• Investigate inconsistencies involving driver identities, carrier information, contact numbers, and shipment assignments.

• Identify potential freight fraud, identity mismatches, double-brokering indicators, and other suspicious activities.

• Immediately escalate high-risk concerns to Carrier Sales, Operations, and Management.

• Ensure questionable or unverified assignments are escalated and appropriately resolved before freight movement.



Escalation Management & Operational Decision-Making

• Serve as the first point of escalation for QA associates handling complex or unresolved verification issues.

• Investigate discrepancies between rate confirmations, TMS records, carrier instructions, driver information, and shipment documents.

• Make timely, informed decisions within established authority and escalate matters requiring management approval.

• Coordinate with Carrier Sales, Track & Trace, and Operations to resolve verification delays, missing information, and potential service failures.

• Prioritize urgent operational concerns based on fraud risk, pickup deadlines, shipment impact, and customer requirements.

• Ensure unresolved issues are properly documented, assigned, and followed through until resolution.

• Communicate critical i
 to management with clear findings, actions taken, and recommended next steps.



Driver Coordination & Tracking Oversight

• Ensure assigned drivers are contacted and properly informed of pickup and delivery details, appointment times, and equipment requirements.

• Oversee the accuracy of driver information entered into the Transportation Management System (TMS).

• Monitor GPS tracking assignments and ensure tracking readiness before scheduled pickups.

• Ensure CDL verification links are sent and outstanding requirements are followed up on promptly.

• Verify that team-driver assignments meet the required confirmation procedures.

• Step in to conduct driver or dispatcher calls when necessary to resolve urgent issues or support the team.

• Ensure no assigned load is overlooked due to incomplete follow-ups or unclear ownership.



Performance Monitoring, Reporting & Process Improvement

• Track daily QA performance, including load verification completion, documentation accuracy, outstanding requirements, and unresolved escalations.

• Monitor individual productivity and identify associates who require additional coaching or support.

• Prepare clear operational updates and performance reports for management.

• Review recurring verification errors, missed follow-ups, and operational bottlenecks.

• Recommend improvements to workflows, verification procedures, and quality control processes.

• Support onboarding and training of new QA associates to ensure they understand operational expectations and SOPs.

• Promote a culture of accuracy, urgency, accountability, and continuous improvement.



What Success Looks Like

• All assigned next-day loads are reviewed and verified before pickup.

• QA associates consistently complete required verification steps accurately and on time.

• Driver information, CDL verification, tracking assignments, and check calls are properly documented.

• Potential freight fraud indicators are identified early and escalated immediately.

• High-risk or unresolved verification issues are not overlooked or allowed to progress without appropriate action.

• Workloads are distributed fairly and effectively, and the team consistently meets operational deadlines.

• Individual performance is monitored, and recurring errors are addressed through coaching and accountability.

• Carrier Sales, Operations, and Management have clear visibility into verification progress and outstanding concerns.

• Shift handovers are organized, with no critical tasks left without ownership.

--------------------------------------------------------------

Why This Role Is a Big Opportunity for You



This is a marketing-only role. No side projects, no wearing five hats. Your one job is to market, and your one metric is clear: deliver Marketing Qualified Leads (MQLs).



You won't be handed a mess and told to figure it out. You'll step into a defined process, with clear expectations, and full ownership of the results.



We're a company that runs on constant, high-volume content and smart systems. We run on our own custom-built CRM and software, so you'll be working with tools designed around how we actually operate. You'll work directly with our founder and team, your ideas get implemented, and as we expand across markets, your scope, influence, and compensation grow with it.

--------------------------------------------------------------

What You'll Be Doing



Lead Generation (Your #1 Priority)

- Own the delivery of Marketing Qualified Leads (MQLs) as your primary metric

- Keep the final result looking good and professional, but not overly edited

Coaching Our Agents

- Coach agents on camera so they get more comfortable and improve their delivery over time

- Create simple training or reference content, like a short example video or quick tip sheet, so agents know what to aim for before they film

- Keep raw clips organized by person and topic, and communicate clearly when footage is missing something



AI & Marketing Automation

- Use AI tools daily to work faster and smarter

- Build AI-powered marketing workflows and automations that create, repurpose, and schedule content

- Work with our custom CRM and software to connect marketing to lead tracking and follow-up

- Turn repetitive marketing tasks into simple, documented systems



Vendor & Partner Communication

) for conversions and clear calls-to-action

 nurture sequences and keep leads cleanly segmented and tagged

- Someone intelligent, hardworking, and humble, who takes feedback and keeps improving

- Someone who keeps things simple, because simple scales

 marketing and CRM lead management

We are bringing all marketing in-house. Your job is to turn ad spend into signed leases at the lowest cost the market allows. The large community alone carries a six-figure annual ad budget and needs roughly 1,300 leads a month.





What you will own

• Google Ads: brand search, high-intent local search and Maps for every property, within Google's housing ad rules (no ZIP code, age or gender targeting)

• Meta Ads under the Housing special ad category: lead forms with qualifying questions, retargeting and weekly creative tests, in English and Spanish

• Listing sites (
, Zillow, Apartment List): packages, listing quality and total monthly price shown on every listing

• Google Tag Manager and conversion tracking: one standard setup on every property, verified with a real test lead

• One campaign structure and naming convention across every account

• Budget pacing, plus monthly allocation that moves money toward the properties with the most empty apartments

• Removing booked and signed leads from ad audiences wherever the platform allows

• Weekly reporting by source: spend, leads, cost per lead, tours and signed leases



How we measure you

• Cost per lead 10% lower than the month before, every month

• Any source above $500 per signed lease after 60 days gets cut, and its budget moves to the best performer

• Cost per signed lease, by source, reported every week





In your first 60 days

• Before January 1: every account for the large community built under our ownership, campaigns built and paused, and tracking tested end to end

• January 1: Google, Meta and listing-site campaigns live on day one

• Day 30: first cost-per-lease review by source, with cuts and shifts made

• By day 60: Spanish ad sets running, retargeting live, all 10+ properties on the standard campaign structure, and cost per signed lease reported for every property



Requirements

• 3+ years managing Google Ads and Meta Ads for lead generation with real budgets

• Experience with Meta special ad categories (housing, employment or credit) and Google's housing ad policies

• Strong with Google Tag Manager, GA4 and conversion tracking

• Experience managing several accounts or locations at once

• You report in leads and cost per signed customer, not clicks and impressions

• Strong written English

• Can confidently run Spanish-language campaigns



Nice to have

• Apartment, real estate or local service business experience

• Experience with 
, Zillow or other listing-site advertising

• Google Ads and Meta certifications



Compensation:

Between $1,300 to $1,600 based on experience + performance based bonuses that we establish together.
