title: Real Estate Operations Manager
description:
About the Role



We are looking for a highly detail-oriented Real Estate Executive Operations Manager to serve as the operational backbone of our fast-paced real estate team.



This is not a passive administrative desk. You will bridge the gap between high-stakes contract-to-close transaction management and executive operations—working directly alongside our lead agent, external marketing and tech specialists, title/lender partners, and brokerage compliance.



Key Responsibilities

1. Contract-to-Close Transaction & Compliance Management

End-to-End File Management: Manage active buyer and seller files from executed contract through closing, recording, and post-close wrap-up (MLS closeout, lockbox/sign retrieval, utility transfers, and key/manual handoffs).



Brokerage Compliance & Commission Unblocking: Audit files in BoldTrail and TransactionDesk / Authentisign to ensure every required Arizona (AAR) form (SPDS, BINSR, ABAD, Buyer-Broker Agreements, signing certificates) is properly executed and uploaded within strict deadlines to prevent holds on Commission Disbursement Authorizations (CDAs).



Inspection & Repair Coordination: Track BINSR timelines, gather itemized contractor bids, coordinate termite/home-warranty orders, and compile clean repair-versus-credit packages for client review.



Title, Lender & Client Handoffs: Coordinate wire cutoffs, walkthrough schedules, pre-qualification uploads, and closing readiness updates across title officers, lenders, and clients.



2. Executive Operations & Vendor Coordination

Multi-Channel Triage & EOD Reporting: Monitor incoming requests across
, RingCentral/SMS, and team workspaces, translating rapid-fire updates into concrete deadlines (anchored to Arizona time) and delivering a structured End-of-Day (EOD) status report with task IDs, blockers, and links to proof.



Cross-Team Project Orchestration: Act as the central point of contact between the lead agent and external specialists (social media, video production, web/SEO, and bookkeeping)—tracking deliverable proofs without duplicating work.



Software, Billing & Brand Hygiene: Maintain our internal tools inventory, track software cancellations/disputes through to written confirmation, manage RingCentral call/voi
 routing, and ensure consistent HREG / EveryPlace branding across Zillow, Flexmls, Google Business Profile, and
 signatures.



3. CRM & Client Experience Operations

Database Integrity (Follow Up Boss): Maintain clean contact records, log detailed call/voi
 notes, segment audiences for targeted outreach, and enforce strict SMS "STOP" opt-out and data-retention rules.



Client Touchpoints & Tours: Prepare buyer tour itineraries/CMAs, send post-consultation seller prep checklists, and manage active-client communication preferences and listing alerts.



What We’re Looking For

Required Experience:



2+ years of experience as a Real Estate Transaction Coordinator, Real Estate Executive Assistant, or Operations Manager (Arizona real estate experience and familiarity with AAR forms strongly preferred).



Proven proficiency in BoldTrail (or kvCORE), TransactionDesk / Authentisign, Follow Up Boss, Flexmls / ARMLS, Aligned Showings / Supra, and Google Workspace.



Experience working within RingCentral (or similar multi-line VoIP/SMS platforms).



Core Strengths:



Obsession with Closing Loops: You follow up persistently until you have written confirmation or an approved file in hand—never assuming an
 sent equals a task done.



Deadline Precision: When given a general timeframe ("tomorrow" or "soon"), you instinctively clarify exact clock cutoffs and manage schedules strictly on Arizona time.



Calm Under Shifting Priorities: You can drop a routine marketing audit to urgently clear a title wire hold, and seamlessly pick the audit back up afterward without dropping a single detail.



High Integrity & Discretion: Comfortable handling sensitive client records, wire/commission details, and account access protocols cleanly and securely.

title: Google & Meta Media Buyer | Creative Testing + AI Production
description:
Ikan Media is looking for a hands-on media buyer who can independently run approved Google and Meta campaigns and own the creative-testing loop. We acquire subscribers for US research-opportunity brands and monetize through lead/affiliate offers and
. A cheap lead is not necessarily a valuable subscriber.



This is a long-term remote role for someone who already knows how to buy media, diagnose results and make practical ad creatives. Our tools and company-specific training should enhance your skills—not supply missing fundamentals.



WHAT YOU WILL OWN

• Google Search and Meta campaign builds, monitoring, optimization and controlled tests within approved budgets and guardrails.

• Creative angles, hooks, copy and short scripts; usable static ads and basic short video/motion using tools you already know.

• Tracking QA, saved-state verification, clear change logs and prompt risk escalation.

• Decisions based on lead quality, downstream revenue and payback—not platform ROAS or CPL alone.

• Concise daily updates and a weekly decision memo without the owner chasing you.



WHAT YOU MUST DEMONSTRATE

• Personal, hands-on Google and Meta experience, with campaign examples and measurable outcomes.

• Sound judgment about attribution gaps, data maturity, budget limits and when to stop and ask.

• Creative work you personally produced and can explain—not only work delivered by another team.

• Practical AI use: good inputs, fact-checking, useful output, corrections and responsible data handling.

• Clear written English, reliable follow-through and disclosed outside commitments.



Relevant affiliate, lead-generation or subscriber-acquisition experience is strongly preferred. Snapchat and NewsBreak experience is useful; we do not expect equal expertise in every channel on day one. No on-camera filming or advanced animation is required. This is not a general-VA, organic-social posting or account-management-only role.



PAY AND SCHEDULE

$1,500–$2,000 USD/month; full-time, 40 hours/week. At least four working hours each day must overlap 9am–5pm America/New_York (Eastern Time, including daylight-saving changes). Exact work arrangement and payment terms will be agreed before an offer. No percentage-of-ad-spend commission.



HOW TO APPLY

Send a short reply with existing, redacted examples:

1. One Google and one Meta campaign: dates, objective, spend you personally controlled, results, data source and what you changed.

2. One static and one short video you personally made. Explain your contribution and share performance data if available.

3. One AI workflow you use, including a mistake you caught and corrected, plus an existing sample change log or owner update if available.

4. Your monthly pay expectation, availability, Eastern overlap and current commitments.



Do not share client credentials or private customer data. Confidentiality-safe examples are welcome; no new unpaid production assignment is required to apply. Finalists receive a structured interview and a short paid practical assessment, with scope and fees agreed before starting. AI is allowed with disclosure; you must defend your own decisions.

title: Client Project Manager (Part-Time, US Hours)
description:
*Initial Applications will not be reviewed until November 30th at the earliest due to the Thanksgiving US holiday. The listing will remain open until at least then.*



Visit this link for a video explanation of this role by Travis Rose:





ABOUT GROWING ROSES



Growing Roses is a consulting firm run entirely by Travis Rose in Dallas, TX. Travis helps companies across every industry and department — finance, legal, HR, operations, development, L&D — design and configure ClickUp around how they actually work.





THE ROLE



Title: Client Project Manager (contract, part-time, remote)

Hours: 20 hours/week

Schedule: Available for client calls 12:00–4:00 PM US Central, Monday–Thursday (2:00–6:00 AM Philippine time; 1:00–5:00 AM during US daylight saving time). Remaining ~4 hours flexible.

Pay: $1,000 USD/month, rising to $1,200/month once month-3 milestones are met (typically ~90 days), plus a 13th-month bonus each December

Type: Independent contractor, with intent to build a long-term relationship

Availability: As soon as possible





WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS



Projects slow down when action items slip — both by Travis and his clients. Travis is strong at discovery and solution design, but weaker at follow-up and keeping many threads organized across projects. This role owns the follow-through so projects move faster and nothing falls through the cracks.





WHAT YOU'LL DO



• Attend all client calls live, with camera on

• Capture clear minutes and action items: who, what, by when

• Keep action items and meeting notes current in each client's ClickUp workspace

• Read back action items at the end of each call

• Open calls by following up on last meeting's items, including the uncomfortable ones

• Chase clients between meetings via
/ClickUp/Slack/etc. when they're blocking progress

• Keep a short cross-client list of what needs Travis's attention, and run a quick priority review with him after calls

• If time remains in the 20 hours after the above is accomplished, assist with admin tasks (logging time, calendar review, etc.)





FIRST 90 DAYS



• Month 1: Attend every call, write minutes and action items. Travis reviews them before they go out.

• Month 2: Run the action item read-back at the end of calls. Minutes go out without review.

• Month 3: Open calls with follow-ups and chase clients between meetings on your own.



These milestones can be met earlier based on Travis's discretion and trust. Pay increases to $1,200/month once Month 3 milestones are met.





REQUIREMENTS 

• Reliably available for live calls 12:00–4:00 PM US Central, Mon–Thu.

• Clear written and spoken English at a fluent conversational level (this is a FIRM requirement) 

• Proactive, organized, and deadline-driven — you follow up without being reminded

• Confident speaking up with senior client stakeholders

• Comfortable learning unfamiliar industries quickly; you don't need to be an expert, just able to capture who, what, and by when

• Experience with flexible work management tools like ClickUp, 
, Notion, Asana, etc. 

• Experience coordinating projects with multiple stakeholders, including clients or other external parties.

• Stable internet, a quiet workspace, and a reliable computer







SECURITY AND CONFIDENTIALITY



Our clients are security-conscious. You'll:

• Sign an NDA, a contractor agreement with IP assignment, and client NDAs where required

• Provide an NBI clearance before your start date

• Use a 1Password vault provided by Growing Roses for all credentials for this work

• Work browser-only, with nothing stored locally





HIRING PROCESS



1. Initial application — When you apply, include:

   • A link to your LinkedIn profile (preferred) or your résumé

   • A link to a video (Loom, Google Drive, or unlisted YouTube) of you answering the following in 5 minutes or less:

      a. Tell me about a time a project stalled because someone else wasn't delivering. What did you do?

      b. How do you keep track of action items across several projects at once?

      c. Our calls are 2–6 AM your time (1–5 AM during US daylight saving time). How would you make that work long term?

2. Interview with Travis (45 minutes, during the US Central meeting window)

3. Paid work sample ($25) — Watch an hour-long recorded client meeting and send the action items and a short summary.

4. References — Two, ideally past managers who can speak to meeting deadlines.

5. Paid trial week ($250) — Sign the NDA first, then attend real client calls, write minutes, and run one read-back.

6. Offer





SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



• Every client call ends with clear, confirmed action items

• Client action items stop slipping for weeks

• Travis's own commitments get done on time

• Travis spends less time organizing and more time solving problems



—



Thanks for reading! I look forward to your application.

, and storms that tear their homes apart, and then we take on the insurance companies for them. We do great work for our clients. The problem is that not enough people know about us yet.



I have the knowledge and the stories. I don’t have time to film content every day, and I don’t want a marketing system that waits on me. I’m hiring someone who can produce a high volume of strong content on their own, using the best AI tools available, and who can build the relationships that bring in new clients.



You won’t be one of ten assistants in a pool. You’ll work directly with me, and what you do will show up in how fast this firm grows. 



What you’ll own, in order of priority



Content: the voice of the firm. You create content from start to finish, without waiting on me to film. You use AI tools (Bloom, Higgsfield and others), along with design and editing tools, to produce reels, short videos, carousels, graphics and explainers that teach people their rights after an a
 or an insurance denial. You write the hooks, scripts and captions. You keep our calendar running at 2 posts a day, 7 days a week, across Instagram,
, LinkedIn and TikTok, and you queue each week’s content for my approval in one batch. You also manage our Google Business Profile and make sure every happy client is asked for a review.



Partner outreach: building our referral network. You research and build lists of local businesses that see injured people every day (chiropractors, physical therapists, body shops, public adjusters, roofers). You reach out by
, LinkedIn and phone, book intro meetings onto my calendar, prepare a short brief before each one, and follow up afterward. You keep every relationship warm in our CRM.



Social lead response: the first reply. When someone messages us after the worst day of their life, you answer quickly and kindly using our scripts, collect their basic info, and get them booked with our intake team. You never give legal advice or talk about case details. We train you on exactly what to say. This takes the least of your time, but when a message comes in, it jumps to the front of the line.



What a week here actually looks like



On Monday you plan the week’s content around what people in South Florida are searching for and worried about: hurricane claims, trucking crashes, insurance denials. By Wednesday, 14 posts are built, captioned and waiting in my approval queue. In between, you send outreach
s, follow up with a chiropractor who opened your message twice, and book two lunch meetings for me on Thursday. A message comes in from someone hurt in a crash on I-95, and you answer within minutes and get them on the phone with our team. On Friday you send me a short report: what posted, what performed, how many meetings got booked, and how many leads came in.



What it’s like to work here



We’re client-centered. Our clients come to us hurting and scared. Everything we put out should make them feel they’ve found people who will actually help.



We’re easygoing about style and serious about standards. No micromanaging and no politics. Deadlines are deadlines, though, and quality matters.



You’ll be heard. If you find a better tool, format or hook, use it and show me the results. I want someone who improves our systems, not just someone who follows them.



You’ll grow. As our marketing grows, this role grows into leading it.



You’re probably the right person if:



You already use AI tools to create images, video and copy, and you can show work that doesn’t look like generic AI

You’ve grown a business’s social accounts and can show the numbers

You know what makes someone stop scrolling within the first 2 seconds

You write natural, conversational English, warm without being stiff

You can produce a high volume of content without sacrificing quality

You’re comfortable reaching out to US business owners you don’t know

You’d rather fix a problem first and tell me afterward than wait to be told

You know CapCut, Canva, Premiere or similar. Meta Business Suite, Google Business Profile and CRM experience are all a plus

You can work US Eastern hours with reliable internet and a reliable computer



This probably isn’t for you if you need someone to hand you raw material and a task list every morning, or if reaching out to strangers and hearing “no” sometimes sounds stressful rather than exciting.



What we offer



$400–$900 USD/month depending on experience, with raises tied to performance

Paid access to professional AI and design tools

Long-term, stable full-time work

Direct mentorship from the Managing Partner

Real ownership of a growing firm’s marketing, and a path to lead it



How to apply



Start your message with the words “Ready to Grow” so I know you read this far. Then send:



Links to at least 3 pieces of content you created (video, carousel, or AI-assisted work), plus the results if you have them

A short note (a few sentences is plenty) answering: Which AI tools do you use to create content, and how do you keep it from looking generic?

Your expected monthly rate



Shortlisted applicants will do a short paid test task: creating a short piece of content from a topic we give you and drafting a referral outreach
.

We want someone who understands what makes an ad convert, can independently develop creative ideas, and knows how to turn them into engaging, high-performing ads. You'll have plenty of creative freedom to experiment with different hooks, angles, storytelling approaches, and formats.



**What You'll Be Doing**

- Research competitor ads, customer pain points, reviews, objections, and creative trends to identify new angles worth testing.

- Study our existing winning ads, analyse Meta performance, and develop meaningful iterations to improve results.

- Prepare a weekly creative testing plan outlining what ads to create, which angles to test, and the reasoning behind them.

- Work closely with our editor, review finished ads, and provide feedback to ensure the creative vision is executed well.



**Who We're Looking For**



- Proven experience developing direct-response video ads for eCommerce brands (ideally 7+ figures brand), particularly on Meta.

- Proven track record of achieving meaningful results with the ads you've developed.

- Strong understanding of direct-response performance marketing, buyer psychology, what stops scroll, storytelling, and what makes an ad convert.

- Excellent scriptwriting and copywriting skills, with the ability to create natural, relatable, and persuasive ads.

- Experience analysing creative performance and developing iterations of winning ads.

- Able to work independently, take ownership of creative strategy, and consistently bring fresh ideas.

- Creative, proactive, reliable, and a good communicator.

- Experience creating ads for UK audiences or the ability to write scripts tailored to different regions.

- Interest in the automotive or security niche is a plus, but not essential.



You don't need professional video editing skills. We're looking for someone who knows what ads to create, why they should work, and how to communicate that vision to an editor. 



Competitive compensation based on experience, with performance bonuses for exceptional results and opportunities to grow into a larger creative leadership role.



To apply please tell us:



Your experience working as a Creative Strategist.

Your portfolio, best ad concepts, scripts and finished creatives.

Any performance results from ads you've developed (spend, CPA, ROAS, etc.).

A brief introduction to your creative research and testing process.



Please note shortlisted candidates will be invited to complete a short creative strategy test.

 and fix their computer problems, by talking them through it and by connecting to their computer with TeamViewer. You will document each support case clearly.



WHAT OUR CUSTOMERS CALL ABOUT

- Computers that are slow, freeze, crash or restart on their own

- Computers that won't start, get stuck on the logo screen, or need a BIOS setting changed

- Windows updates that fail or break something, and Windows 10 to 11 upgrades

YOU MUST HAVE

- At least 2 years of phone or remote technical support for U.S. customers

- Strong Windows 10 and 11 troubleshooting: Device Manager, drivers, updates, recovery, display settings

- Enough hardware knowledge to walk a customer through BIOS settings, drives, cables and adapters, and power problems by phone. Hands-on PC building or repair is a plus.

- Experience with TeamViewer or similar remote tools

- A quiet home office, a good headset, and internet of at least 50 Mbps

- Full-time availability during U.S. Eastern business hours

- Comfortable with a ticketing or CRM system, or able to learn one quickly



You do not need to know everything on day one, but you must have real-world experience with Windows and with supporting customers on live calls.



WHY WORK WITH US

This is not a short-term contract. We look for long-term working relationships and treat our team with respect. You will get consistent full-time hours, a supportive team, and room to grow into more responsibility. If you do great work, it will be noticed.



HOW TO APPLY

1. Start your message with the words: "Ready to fix it"

2. Record a 2-minute video (Google Drive or unlisted YouTube). Keep your face on camera and answer in your own words. Videos that are read from a screen will not be considered. Pretend I am a customer and say this to you: "My computer froze, I restarted it, and now two of my monitors are black." Talk me through what you would ask and what you would check, out loud.

3. Include your resume, a screenshot of an internet speed test, and a photo of your headset.

4. Put this in the subject line: Phone Support Agent – Your Name



Applications that do not follow these instructions will not be reviewed.

title: Affiliate Program Manager (Shopify, BixGrow) for US Peptide Brand
description:
We're hiring a part-time affiliate manager for People's Peps, a US research peptide brand on Shopify. You'll run our affiliate program day to day in BixGrow: store partners, creators, codes, commissions and payouts. The role starts at 20 hours a week and moves to full time (40 hours) as the program grows.



A heads-up: research peptides are a restricted category. Ad platforms and payment processors watch this space closely, so everything our partners say has to stay inside clear rules. If you've managed affiliates for peptides, kratom, CBD, supplements or nootropics, you already know how this works.



ABOUT US

People's Peps runs on one rule: testing as a default. Every product has its own third-party lab test, published by lot. We sell vials, mists and dissolving strips direct to researchers, and wholesale to shops and distributors across the US. We're a small, founder-led team in Austin, Texas. You'll report to our marketing manager.



Our goal is for you to make a lot of money as you help us scale. This role runs on relationships, so we want someone who genuinely enjoys building them.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Hunt for new affiliates: find, pitch and sign creators, reviewers, community voices and shops in the research peptide space. This is the first job.

- Run our partner stores as affiliates: set up their accounts, codes and links, and help their staff sell inside the rules.

- Host weekly office hours and webinars for store partners and affiliates through Calendly, and coach them to better results.

- Run the program in BixGrow: commission tiers, custom store rates, coupons, links, the affiliate portal and fraud checks.

- Track commissions, handle refunds, and prep monthly payouts and W-9s with our ops team.

- Work with our sales reps on the stores they bring in, and with marketing on code cards and partner materials.

- Review partner content and pull codes from anyone who breaks the rules.

- Send a short weekly report: sales by partner, new and active partners, commission cost, problems.

- Later on, help with the affiliate program for our sister brand as time allows.



THE RULES EVERY PARTNER FOLLOWS

- Research use only. Compounds are "researched for," never "used for."

- No dosing, no health claims, no before-and-after content, no "helping people" language.

- 21+ only.

You'll teach these to every partner and hold them to it, top earners included.



SCHEDULE

- 20 hours a week, flexible.

- At least 4 hours a day inside US Central business hours, 9 AM to 5 PM CT (11 PM to 7 AM Philippine time), for store office hours, webinars and team calls.

- We work in Shopify, BixGrow, Slack, Google Workspace and Calendly.

- Hours are tracked with time tracking software that takes screenshots. If that doesn't work for you, please don't apply.



PAY

- $900 to $1,200 USD a month at 20 hours.

- Full time moves to $1,800 to $2,400 USD a month.

- Plus 2% commission on sales from the affiliates you recruit and manage.

- Paid by Wise, or another method that works for both of us.

- Long-term role.



YOU'RE A FIT IF YOU

- Have 2+ years running an affiliate or creator program for a Shopify brand, with numbers to show.

- Have used BixGrow, UpPromote, GoAffPro, Refersion or something similar.

- Have worked in a restricted category: peptides, kratom, CBD, supplements or vape.

- Are comfortable on video calls with US shop owners.

- Speak and write excellent English. You'll be on calls and webinars with US partners, and a phone call is one of our d
 factors.

- Have a reliable internet connection and a backup.

Bonus if you know peptide or biohacking creators, or have run a B2B or retail partner program.



HOW TO APPLY

Send a short intro and answer these two questions:

1. Tell us about one affiliate program you grew: where it started, what you changed, and the numbers 90 days later.

2. A store partner asks you to help word a social post about what a peptide "does." What do you tell them?



Start your application with the word RESEARCH. Applications without it won't be reviewed.

HOW TO APPLY

title: Operations Support Specialist
description:
Remote | Full-Time | Long-Term Opportunity | Philippines



About Realty Hub



Realty Hub is an established U.S. real estate brokerage operating across Florida, Georgia, and Alabama.



Our remote operations team supports real estate agents through documented procedures, internal systems, and a centralized knowledge base. We focus on providing accurate, dependable support while continuously improving how our business operates.



We’re looking for a reliable, detail-oriented professional who enjoys learning, researching information, solving problems, and taking ownership of their work.



Prior real estate experience is not required. What matters most is your ability to learn, follow procedures accurately, think independently, and apply what you’ve learned.



We’re seeking someone interested in building a long-term professional relationship with our company.



About the Role

As an Operations Support Specialist, your initial responsibilities will focus on live chat support, routine agent inquiries, and basic operational assistance.



You’ll learn to navigate our internal resources, locate accurate information, assist agents, and recognize when a question requires additional review or escalation.



As you demonstrate proficiency, you may gradually take on additional operational responsibilities.



We’re not looking for someone who simply memorizes answers. We’re looking for someone who can research, understand, verify, and apply information independently.



Primary Responsibilities



Agent Support & Live Chat

Respond to agent inquiries through live chat and other assigned support channels.

Research answers using standard operating procedures (SOPs), company policies, and internal resources.

Communicate clearly, accurately, and professionally.

Identify situations requiring additional review or escalation.

Document inquiries and complete necessary follow-ups.



Operational Support

Follow established procedures for assigned administrative tasks.

Review information and documents for completeness and accuracy.

Maintain accurate records, trackers, and task statuses.

Verify required information before completing assigned workflows.

Track pending tasks and follow through without repeated reminders.

Additional Responsibilities as You Develop



Depending on your progress, you may gradually learn:



Agent onboarding and activation workflows.

License transfers and listing-related administrative tasks.

Basic transaction document review.

Additional operational systems and procedures.

SOP updates and knowledge base improvements.

Advanced responsibilities are introduced gradually, based on demonstrated proficiency and operational needs.



How We Work

We don’t expect you to know every answer or memorize every procedure.



We do expect you to:



Research before asking: Consult available documentation and resources before seeking assistance.

Understand, not just memorize: Learn why procedures exist so you can apply them to different situations.

Follow through: Track unfinished tasks and ensure nothing is overlooked.

Verify information: Prioritize accuracy over speed.

Use sound judgment: Recognize when to investigate further and when to escalate.

Learn from feedback: Apply corrections and avoid repeating preventable mistakes.

Take ownership: Be accountable for your responsibilities and communicate proactively.

Asking questions is encouraged. We value thoughtful questions that demonstrate preparation, effort, and a willingness to learn.



Training & Professional Development

We provide structured onboarding and ongoing opportunities to develop your professional skills.



Your initial training will include:

Guided navigation of our SOPs and support resources.

Introduction to internal systems and workflows.

Practical exercises and simulated agent inquiries.

Supervised live chat and operational tasks.

Regular feedback and progress reviews.

Training begins with a limited number of responsibilities. As your accuracy, confidence, and independence improve, additional tasks may be introduced.



We evaluate progress based on your ability to perform assigned work correctly, consistently, and with decreasing supervision—not simply how quickly you complete training.



What Success Looks Like



First 30 Days

Become comfortable navigating our SOPs and support resources.

Demonstrate effective research and reading comprehension.

Complete introductory training and practical exercises.

Begin handling selected routine inquiries and tasks with appropriate supervision.

Demonstrate attention to detail, accountability, and willingness to learn.



Days 31–60

Handle assigned routine tasks with increasing independence.

Consistently track pending work and complete follow-ups.

Apply previously learned procedures to similar situations.

Recognize when an issue requires escalation.

Demonstrate measurable improvement in accuracy and efficiency.



Days 61–90

Independently manage assigned responsibilities with consistent accuracy.

Handle routine agent inquiries confidently.

Maintain reliable task ownership and follow-through.

Demonstrate readiness to learn additional operational workflows.

Progression is based on demonstrated performance and may vary depending on assigned responsibilities.



Compensation & Benefits

Starting rate: $5.00 USD per hour, based on a 40-hour workweek.



Higher starting compensation may be considered for exceptionally qualified candidates based on demonstrated experience and capabilities.



13th-month pay provided annually in December.

Paid holidays in accordance with company policy.

Three paid wellness days annually, allocated quarterly during the first three quarters.

Structured training and opportunities for continued professional development.

Opportunities to participate in company-sponsored employee retreats, subject to eligibility and company arrangements.

Long-term opportunity with an established U.S. real estate brokerage.

We value the well-being of our team members and believe that professional development, personal wellness, and a supportive work environment contribute to long-term success.



Work Schedule

Full-Time Remote Position — 40 Hours Per Week

Regular work schedule: Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time.

Initial training: Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time, for approximately two weeks.

Because the position follows U.S. Eastern Time, working hours in the Philippines will generally be:

9:00 PM–5:00 AM Philippine Time during U.S. daylight saving time.

10:00 PM–6:00 AM Philippine Time during U.S. standard time.



Applicants must be comfortable maintaining this overnight schedule on a long-term basis.



Reliable availability during assigned working hours is essential.



Required Qualifications

Excellent written and spoken English.

Strong reading comprehension and attention to detail.

Ability to research, understand, and apply unfamiliar information.

Strong organizational and follow-through skills.

Comfortable navigating websites, documentation, and multiple software systems.

Ability to work independently while following established procedures.

Good judgment, professionalism, and accountability.

Willingness to receive feedback and continuously improve.

Reliable availability during assigned working hours.

Previous experience in customer support, administrative operations, or process-driven work is helpful but not required.



We place greater importance on demonstrated ability, reliability, and willingness to learn than on job titles or years of experience alone.



Equipment & Connectivity Requirements



Reliable computer suitable for multitasking.

Stable primary internet connection.

Backup internet connection.

Reliable backup power arrangement for internet and computer equipment.

Quiet, professional workspace.

Headset suitable for voice communication.

Second monitor recommended but not required.

Applicants should be prepared to explain their backup arrangements and how they would maintain availability during internet or power interruptions.



How to Apply

Please include the following information in your application:



Brief introduction and relevant work experience.

Expected hourly rate in USD.

Current location in the Philippines.

Primary internet provider and recently tested connection speed.

Backup internet solution.

Backup power arrangement.

Computer and equipment specifications.

Confirmation that you can work the required U.S. Eastern Time schedule on a long-term basis.



Please also answer the following two questions using specific examples from your own experience.



Question 1 — Independent Problem-Solving



Describe a time you encountered a work-related problem you didn’t know how to solve. What steps did you take, what resources did you use, and what was the outcome?



Question 2 — Accountability & Follow-Through



Tell us about a time you overlooked a task or made a mistake at work. How did you address it, and what did you change to prevent it from happening again?



We value specific, thoughtful answers that reflect your actual experience.



Our Selection Process

Shortlisted applicants may be invited to complete a practical assessment involving research, reading comprehension, resource navigation, problem-solving, and task organization.



This assessment is designed to evaluate how you approach unfamiliar situations, locate information, and apply instructions accurately.



Finalists will be invited to an interview.



Important Application Instructions

Please complete all requested information and answer both application questions.



Incomplete applications may not be considered.



We value clear communication, careful reading, genuine effort, and professionalism throughout the application process.



We’re looking for someone who wants to learn, contribute, and grow with Realty Hub over the long term.

title: Technical Customer Success Manager, English + Spanish (Fintech / Payments, Remote)
description:
About us



Disputely is a US fintech company that helps online stores stop chargebacks before they happen. We connect merchants to the card networks' alert programs (Visa and Mastercard), so disputes are caught and refunded automatically instead of becoming chargebacks. Our customers are e-commerce brands, many selling on Shopify and Stripe, and payment partners who resell our service.



We are growing fast and need someone who can handle the technical side of customer success: integrations, API questions and our biggest accounts.



The role



You will be the go-to person for technical questions from merchants and partners. Today those questions go straight to our founders. Your job is to take them over, solve them, and make sure our largest clients get a hands-on, technical point of contact.



What you will do



Be the dedicated technical contact for our high-volume merchants (5,000+ alerts a month).

Answer API, webhook and integration questions from merchants and partners (Shopify, Stripe, payment gateways, CRMs, help desk tools).

Troubleshoot problems end to end: reproduce the issue, read the logs or API responses, find the cause, and write a clear report for our developers when it is a bug.

Help merchants and partners connect to our API and set up custom flows.

Run onboarding and check-in video calls with merchants, explaining technical things in plain English.

Reply to merchants in our help desk, live chat and group chats (Slack, WhatsApp,
).

Write and update help articles, FAQs and step-by-step guides for technical topics.

Look after our reputation: follow up with happy merchants for reviews, and step in fast when a merchant is unhappy.

Requirements



3+ years in a technical customer-facing role: technical support, customer success, account management, solutions or implementation, ideally at a SaaS or fintech company.

Real hands-on API experience. You can read API documentation, understand requests, responses and webhooks, and test endpoints with Postman or a similar tool.

Comfortable with JSON and reading error logs.

Excellent written and spoken English. You will be on calls with US clients.

Fluent written and spoken Spanish. You will support our Spanish-speaking merchants on calls and in chat.

Clear, short writing. You can explain a technical problem in three sentences.

Organized and reliable with follow-ups. Nothing falls through the cracks.

Stable internet, a quiet workspace, and a working camera and headset.

Available during US Pacific business hours.

Big pluses



Experience in payments, e-commerce, fraud or chargebacks.

Experience with Shopify, Stripe or payment gateways.

Experience with help desk tools like Pylon, Intercom or Zendesk.

Basic SQL or scripting.

Experience handling a brand's public reviews or social media replies.

What we offer



Long-term, full-time remote role with a growing US company.

Direct work with the founders and the customer success lead.

Training on our product and the card networks' alert programs.

Room to grow as the team grows.

How to apply



Send the following.

( Applications missing any of these will not be reviewed. )



Your CV. to 

A short Loom or video (2 minutes max) introducing yourself: first half in English, second half in Spanish.

Answers to these three questions: 

a. Tell us about one API you have worked with. 

What did you use it for, and what problem did you solve? 

b. A merchant says: "Our refunds stopped syncing yesterday." 

What are the first three things you check? 

c. Describe a time you turned an unhappy customer around.

Write "DISPUTELY TECH" as the subject of your application so we know you read the full post.

Shortlisted applicants will be asked to complete a short skills test.

title: SketchUp Drafter & Landscape Designer | Full-Time Remote
description:
Red Branch Outdoor Living is a residential design-build company in South Alabama. We build decks, patio covers, pavilions, outdoor kitchens, and landscaped outdoor spaces.



We’re looking for someone who enjoys both sides of design: figuring out how an outdoor space should look and feel, and drawing it clearly enough for a crew to build. On one project, you might turn field measurements into a 3D model of a deck and patio cover. On the next, you might design the planting beds and help our salesperson show the homeowner how the whole backyard will come together.



You’ll work directly with our sales team, structural engineers, and production team. Your drawings will be used in client conversations, engineering reviews, and on real jobsites.



What you’ll do

- Model outdoor projects in SketchUp and produce 2D and 3D concept drawings from site photos, field measurements, and the salesperson’s notes.

- Create construction drawing sets for decks, patio covers, pavilions, and outdoor kitchens. Include scaled plans, elevations, sections, and details our crews can use in the field.

- Design planting layouts around how people move through the space. Use sun and shade, soil moisture, drainage, mature plant size, spacing, and maintenance needs to choose what goes where.

- Create a scaled planting plan and plant schedule with labeled locations and quantities by plant type. Review it with the salesperson and flag any site questions the team needs to resolve.

- Coordinate drawing revisions and keep projects organized in JobTread. Work with engineers on redlines, answer drawing questions from the field, and keep the latest plans easy to find.



What we’re looking for

- Experience with SketchUp or comparable 3D drafting software and the ability to produce clear, dimensioned construction drawings.

- A portfolio that shows both technical drafting and planting or landscape design.

- Practical knowledge of how outdoor structures are assembled and an eye for how decks, paths, patios, and planting beds fit together.

- Ability to research plants suited to South Alabama and explain why your selections fit the site.

- Clear written English for drawing notes, questions, and team updates, along with reliable internet for remote work.

- SketchUp LayOut, JobTread, and U.S. residential permit drawing experience are advantages.

Please visit this link to fill out our application and we will reach out to you!

s, and inquiries promptly, and escalate urgent or unresolved issues to the right team member.

11. Log project updates, customer notes, and documents accurately in our internal systems (Google Workspace, Zoho, or similar).

12. Handle filing, document organization, data entry, and report preparation.

**What we're looking for**

1. Experience in solar permitting, interconnection, or incentive program administration is strongly preferred. Experience in construction, utilities, or project administration also counts.

2. Strong written and verbal English, with a friendly, professional phone manner.

4. Comfortable with Google Workspace (Sheets, Drive, Docs) and willing to learn CRM and project tracking tools.

6. A proactive problem-solver who works well independently and stays calm under pressure.

1. Competitive pay in USD, based on experience

2. A long-term, full-time role with room to grow

Send your updated resume and a brief cover letter describing your relevant experience and why you're a good fit. Include "permitting" in your subject line.

title: Senior Meta Ads Media Buyer & AI Advertising Strategist

, Instagram & TikTok

We're the team behind Art of Homage, an established Christian Streetwear brand that has generated over $30 million in revenue, and EntreBeliever, an e-commerce education and consulting company helping entrepreneurs build successful online brands.



We're looking for an experienced, results-driven media buyer who understands how to build, optimize, and profitably scale advertising campaigns.



Our ideal candidate is highly proficient in Meta Ads, understands the mechanics behind profitable e-commerce growth, and knows how to leverage ChatGPT and AI to increase creative output, improve campaign performance, and identify new opportunities.



**This is not a position for someone who simply launches ads. We need someone who knows how to SCALE them.**



Primary Responsibilities — Art of Homage 



Campaign Management & Scaling



- Take ownership of our
 and Instagram advertising campaigns.

- Build and manage profitable campaign structures for an established Shopify apparel brand.

- Develop strategies for scaling winning ads while maintaining target profitability.

Performance Reporting

- Deliver weekly reports identifying wins, losses, growth opportunities, and recommended adjustments.

- Develop clear action plans when advertising performance declines.



Secondary Responsibilities — EntreBeliever

- Understand the differences between advertising physical products and digital education programs.

- Optimize acquisition costs, lead quality, and conversion performance.

Required Experience



- 3–5+ years of hands-on Meta Ads management.

- Proven track record scaling Shopify e-commerce brands.

- Strong knowledge of Meta Ads Manager, campaign structure, and budget optimization.

- Experience with
, Instagram, and TikTok advertising.

Someone who recognizes a winning creative and understands how to scale it.



Someone who uses AI to work faster and smarter.

title: Experienced Amazon Online Arbitrage Sourcer | FBA & FBM | Full-Time
description:
Experienced sourcers only. Serious applicants only. Apply only if you can independently find, verify, and submit purchase-ready Amazon Online Arbitrage leads from day one. You must be proficient with SellerAmp, confident in advanced Keepa analysis, and able to calculate profitability accurately for both FBA and FBM.



Remote · 40 hours per week · Flexible schedule · $4 USD/hour starting + performance bonuses · Paid trial



You’ll work for two U.S. Amazon sellers in one full-time role. One seller uses FBA and the other uses FBM. We coordinate priorities and share sourcing standards. Each lead must meet the eligibility and cost requirements of the account it’s submitted for.



Training is limited to our sourcing standards, account-specific costs, eligibility procedures, and reporting workflow. We’ll provide Keepa and SellerAmp access, set priorities, answer questions, and give feedback. You’ll work independently for most of the day and are responsible for verifying each lead before submission.

Daily performance expectations

Our target is 6–8 distinct, purchase-ready leads per eight-hour workday across both sellers combined. The FBA and FBM split will vary based on our priorities.



A lead counts toward the daily target when it’s in stock at submission, matches the Amazon listing exactly, is eligible for the assigned seller, meets our profit and ROI requirements at a Keepa-supported selling price, and has every required field completed. An ASIN that qualifies for both FBA and FBM counts once. Exceptions count only after approval.

What you’ll do

- Source from U.S. retailers using manual sourcing, Keepa Product Finder, reverse sourcing, and storefront research.

- Review 30-, 60-, and 90-day Keepa history for pricing, Buy Box activity, demand, seasonality, Amazon’s presence, and competition. Give particular weight to the most recent 30 days when estimating a realistic selling price.

- Verify the exact match, including brand, model, UPC where available, size, color, quantity, and pack configuration. Flag packaging differences and resolve any uncertainty before submitting a lead as purchase-ready.

- Confirm selling eligibility for the assigned account and flag potential IP concerns.

- Log each lead in our shared Google Sheet. Include the ASIN, retailer link, buy cost, expected selling price, estimated net profit, ROI, estimated monthly sales, competition, and why the lead qualifies for FBA, FBM, or both. Account for variations when estimating demand.

- Send a daily written update and attend a weekly review meeting. Flag sourcing issues promptly and explain any shortfall in qualifying leads.

Sourcing requirements

- Profitability. Minimum 30% ROI and $5 net profit per unit after all applicable costs.

- Demand. Target 100+ estimated monthly sales. Leads with 50–99 require clear justification and approval. Prioritize stable pricing, consistent demand, and replenishment potential.

- Competition. Target fewer than 15 FBA sellers. Leads with 15 or more require approval and an explanation of why demand supports the competition. Evaluate competing FBM offers where relevant.

- Amazon’s presence. Leads where Amazon is selling require approval. Show how historical Buy Box activity, consistent demand, and strong profitability support the opportunity.

- Product restrictions. No hazmat. Submit products the assigned seller can’t sell only when specifically requested for review. Slow-moving, heavy, bulky, oversized, or fragile products require approval. Clothing and shoes require approval and exceptional profitability that justifies the return risk.

- Discounts. Include verified gift-card discounts when instructed. Exclude cashback from qualifying profit and ROI.

Required cost calculations

- FBA. Include applicable Amazon fees, prep, inbound shipping, inbound placement fees, and relevant storage costs.

- FBM. Include applicable Amazon fees, shipping to the customer, and packaging. Use accurate weight and dimensions for the shipping estimate.

- Both. Include applicable retailer shipping and sales tax. We’ll provide the cost assumptions for each seller.

Experience, schedule, and pay

- Proven hands-on Amazon Online Arbitrage sourcing experience. You must be able to evaluate leads for both fulfillment methods. Prior sourcing experience with both FBA and FBM is preferred.

- Strong Google Sheets skills, clear written English, reliable internet, and dependable follow-through. You must be able to explain your decisions and apply feedback.

- 40 hours per week with flexible working hours. Be available for scheduled check-ins as needed between 9:00 and 10:00 a.m. U.S. Eastern Time.

- $4 USD/hour starting, with opportunities to reach $5/hour and beyond through consistent performance. Bonuses may be earned based on lead quality and the sales and profitability generated. We’ll share written bonus terms before the trial.

- This is a long-term role with potential advancement into senior sourcing or team leadership.

How to apply

On the first line of your application, write Favorite color: [your answer]. Then briefly introduce yourself and address all three items below.

1. Your experience. Tell us how long you’ve sourced for Amazon, which tools and methods you use, and what experience you have with FBA and FBM.

2. Two example leads. Share one FBA lead and one FBM lead. For each, include the product, retailer, buy cost, expected selling price, estimated net profit, and ROI. Show which fees and costs you included, what in the Keepa history supports your selling price, and why the lead fits that fulfillment method. Previous or redacted examples are welcome.

3. Your availability. Include your time zone, proposed working hours, availability for the Eastern Time check-in window, and earliest start date.

Finalists will complete a paid sourcing trial and a brief walkthrough of their analysis. During the walkthrough, be ready to explain one lead you passed on during the trial and why. We’ll evaluate how many leads pass review, the accuracy of your analysis, and how independently you work. We’ll agree on the trial scope, pay, and expectations in advance.



We’ll only consider applications that follow every instruction. On the very last line of your application, write Favorite number: [your answer].

title: eCommerce Performance Video Editor & AI Content Creator
description:
We're a fast-growing DTC eCommerce brand in the automotive security niche, having generated approximately £4 million in revenue in our first year.



We're looking for a talented and experienced Video Editor who can turn creative briefs, scripts, and footage into engaging, high-converting video ads.



We have an extensive content library with plenty of footage for you to use when assembling ads. You'll also use AI tools to generate voiceovers, additional B-roll, or even entire AI-generated creatives, depending on the script and creative requirements. All scripts and creative direction will be provided by our Creative Strategist.



**What You'll Be Doing**



- Produce approximately 10–15 video ads per week, including new concepts, winning-ad iterations, and creative variations.

- Edit a wide range of direct-response ads, including short-form, long-form, VSLs, UGC-style, mashups, storytelling, and AI assisted creatives.

- Create realistic AI-generated scenes and talking-head content that blend naturally with real footage.

- Turn scripts and creative briefs into fast-paced, attention-grabbing, conversion-focused videos.

- Source suitable B-roll and footage from our content library or external sources.

- Use AI tools such as Higgsfield, ElevenLabs, and similar platforms to generate additional footage, voiceovers, and creative assets.

- Create variations of winning ads, experimenting with hooks, visuals, pacing, and editing styles.

- Work closely with our Creative Strategist, incorporate feedback, and deliver videos on schedule.



**Who We're Looking For**



- Solid experience editing direct-response video ads for eCommerce brands, particularly Meta.

- Not must but experience working with 7+ figures brand is preferred.

- Skilled in generating high-quality AI content.

- Skilled in CapCut, Premiere Pro or similar editing software.

- Strong portfolio demonstrating different creative styles and formats.

- Good understanding of hooks, storytelling, pacing, and what makes video ads convert.

- Able to independently source or create footage using AI and turn scripts into complete ads.

- A strong team player who communicates clearly, takes feedback well, and can work efficiently with our Creative Strategist to deliver high-quality ads on schedule.

- Efficient, creative, detail-oriented, responsive, and reliable.



We're not looking for flashy editing. We prefer natural, relatable, fast-paced creatives that grab attention and drive results.



Competitive compensation based on experience, production capacity, and quality, with performance-based bonuses and opportunities to grow alongside the brand.



To apply please tell us:



1. Your experience working as a video editor.

2. A portfolio of your best eCommerce video ads (the more the better).

3. Example of you AI generated content or creatives (the more the better).

4. What AI tool and video production software you experienced using.

5. What's your capacity of creative output per month/week.



Shortlisted candidates will be invited to complete a short editing test to create 1-2 ads for us, we will provide brief, script & b-roll content library.

title: Appointment Setter | WFH | UK Estate Agency
description:
Remote | Long-Term Career Growth | Outbound Calls and Appointment Setting

Full-time | 40 Hours per Week | PHP 290 to 330 per Hour starting | Bi-Weekly Pay | Performance Bonuses



Luxury Hub and Pure Green are fast-growing UK-based property companies managing over £20m in assets and securing £30m in investment funding for future developments.



Luxury Hub is an estate and letting agency covering Manchester, Stockport, Lancashire and the wider North West of England. We have a large database of homeowners, landlords and tenants who have already enquired with us, and we are expanding into new areas.



We are expanding our Philippines-based team and are hiring an Appointment Setter with estate agency experience. Your job is to call the people who have enquired with us, find out where they are in their moving journey, and book them in with our UK team.



This is a phone heavy role. You will make 50 to 60 outbound calls a day. If you know the property world, love being on the phone and get a buzz from a full diary, this role is for you.



WHY JOIN US



• Work remotely for a stable UK-based company

• Long-term role with guaranteed hours and job security

• Warm leads: you will be calling people who have already enquired with us

• Gain experience of the UK property market, sales and lettings

• Work closely with senior leadership and our UK valuers

• Training on our systems, scripts and local areas

• Clear progression as the business grows

• Annual performance review with potential pay increase



OUR CULTURE AND VALUES



At Luxury Hub, culture matters. We are building a long term team, not short term contractors.



• Shared Vision – Aligning personal ambition with company success and shared goals

• Virtue and Talents – Individual talents are recognised and nurtured

• Continuous Improvement – We welcome feedback, stay curious, innovate and improve

• Focused Contribution – We play to our strengths and passions to create real impact

• Meaningful Partnerships – We believe in mutual value creation and growing together



WHAT YOU WILL DO



Sales Valuations

• Call homeowners and landlords who requested an online valuation or contacted us through our website and lead providers

• Book in person valuations with our UK valuers

• Re-engage older leads with a clear, friendly script and find out who is ready to move



Lettings

• Call tenants and applicants to book property viewings

• Collect viewing feedback and move interested applicants towards an application

• Support the lettings team with follow up calls when needed



CRM and Diary Management

• Log every call, outcome and note in our CRM (
)

• Set follow up reminders for people who are not ready yet, for example "call me back in six months"

• Coordinate diaries with our UK valuers and viewing agents



Targets and Reporting

• Hit daily call targets and weekly booked appointment targets

• Share call outcomes and feedback to help improve our scripts and lead sources



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



You should have:



• At least 1 year of experience calling for an estate agency, letting agency or real estate business (UK experience strongly preferred; US, Australian or Canadian real estate also considered)

• Proven appointment-setting results you can tell us about: calls per day and appointments booked

• Excellent spoken English, clear and confident on the phone

• Comfortable with rejection and with handling objections in real time

• Good understanding of how property sales and lettings work: valuations, viewings, landlords, tenants and applicants

• Experience using a CRM and a VoIP dialler

• Accurate, organised note-taking

• Quiet workspace, noise-cancelling headset, reliable internet with a backup connection and power backup

• Availability to work UK hours, including some Saturdays

• No other full-time job or full-time study commitments



COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS



Competitive Pay and Bonuses

• PHP 290 to 330 per hour starting rate, based on experience

• Biweekly pay

• Annual performance and pay review

• Appointment bonus for booked appointments that go ahead, available after 12 months of service and subject to agreed KPIs



Bonuses and Incentives

• Thirteenth month pay

• Fourteenth month performance bonus after five years of service

• Bonus days off every 80 hours worked after probation



Long-Term Growth and Stability

• Paid training and career development

• Health stipend after two years of service

• Company loan options after two years of service

• Guaranteed pay security: if we do not provide enough work, you will still be paid for at least 75 percent of your contracted hours



HOW TO APPLY



• Complete this short application form:

• Only applications made through the Google Form will be accepted. Applications sent only through OnlineJobs.ph will not be reviewed.

• The form includes a short voice recording. Applications without the recording will not be reviewed.

• No CV required at this stage.



HIRING TIMELINE



The job posting will close on 13th December 2026 at 11:59 PM UK time. We will review the applications received over the following days and let applicants know the results by 18th December.



Shortlisted candidates will then receive an invite to complete a trial task, due in the first week of January. For candidates who advance, interviews will take place in the 2nd or 3rd week of January. We aim to make a final decision by the end of January, and the successful candidate will begin in the 1st or 2nd week of February.



Note: This timeline may adjust slightly as we progress, especially around the Christmas holidays. We'll keep you informed.



Thank you for your patience and enthusiasm. Join us and grow your career with a UK based estate agency.
